atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 九一八事变 Mukden Incident 沈阳事变 Shenyang Incident
fields.summary: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。 The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。 On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.

fields.name: 一·二八事变 January 28 Incident 淞沪抗战 January 28 Resistance
fields.summary: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。 Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.

fields.name: 哈尔滨沦陷 Fall of Harbin
fields.place: 黑龙江哈尔滨 Harbin, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.
fields.description: 1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control. This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

place.en: Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)

summary.zh: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。
summary.en: Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.

fields.name: 伪满洲国成立 Establishment of Manchukuo
fields.place: 吉林长春（伪满称“新京”） Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)
fields.summary: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。 Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.
fields.description: 1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.

fields.name: 一二·九运动 December Ninth Movement
fields.summary: 北平学生举行抗日救亡请愿游行，推动全国抗日救亡运动高涨。 Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.
fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 9 日，北平学生数千人举行抗日救亡请愿游行，反对华北自治，要求停止内战、一致对外。运动迅速扩展到全国，成为抗日民族统一战线形成的重要背景。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1935, thousands of students in Beiping demonstrated against the autonomy movement in North China and called for an end to civil war and united resistance. The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 西安事变 Xi’an Incident
fields.summary: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。
summary.en: Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.

fields.name: 卢沟桥事变 Marco Polo Bridge Incident 七七事变 July 7 Incident
fields.place: 北平卢沟桥 Marco Polo Bridge, Beiping
fields.summary: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。 Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。
summary.en: China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.

fields.name: 淞沪会战 Battle of Shanghai 八一三事变 August 13 Incident 淞沪抗战 Battle of Shanghai
fields.summary: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。 China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。 The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

summary.en: Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.

fields.name: 忻口会战 Battle of Xinkou 忻口战役 Xinkou Campaign
fields.summary: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。 Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第五师团等部沿同蒲铁路南下，进攻忻口。中国第二战区部队在卫立煌指挥下依托阵地顽强抵抗，双方在忻口一线激战。日军久攻不下，后因娘子关失守、中国军队侧后受威胁，中国军队于 11 月 2 日撤退，太原于 11 月 8 日失守。此役是太原会战的重要组成部分。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In October 1937, Japanese forces including the 5th Division advanced south along the Datong–Pukou railway and attacked Xinkou. Chinese troops of the Second War Zone, commanded by Wei Lihuang, resisted stubbornly from prepared positions in fierce fighting around Xinkou. Unable to break through quickly, the Japanese exploited the fall of Niangziguan and threatened the Chinese flank and rear; Chinese forces withdrew on 2 November, and Taiyuan fell on 8 November. The battle was an important part of the Taiyuan campaign. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 南京沦陷与南京大屠杀 Fall of Nanjing and the Nanjing Massacre 南京大屠杀 Nanjing Massacre 南京保卫战 Defense of Nanjing
fields.summary: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。 After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月 13 日，日军攻占南京。随后数周内，日军在南京及周边地区对放下武器的中国军人和无辜平民实施大规模屠杀、强奸、纵火与抢劫。远东国际军事法庭认定伤亡规模巨大。 本事件为路线分段端点，具体伤亡数字存在不同统计口径，待史料校订。 Japanese forces captured Nanjing on 13 December 1937. In the following weeks they carried out mass killings, rape, arson, and looting against disarmed Chinese soldiers and civilians in and around the city. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East found the scale of the atrocities to be enormous. fields.name: 兰封会战 Battle of Lanfeng 兰封战役 Lanfeng Campaign
fields.place: 河南兰封（今兰考） Lanfeng (now Lankao), Henan
fields.summary: 中国军队围攻兰封日军第 14 师团，因日军增援与协同问题未能全歼，最终撤退。 Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division at Lanfeng; Japanese reinforcements and coordination problems prevented a full encirclement, and the Chinese withdrew.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，徐州会战后期，中国军队在兰封地区围攻日军第 14 师团。中国军队一度收复兰封，但日军增援逼近，中国军队侧背受威胁，被迫撤退。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分，也暴露了指挥协同与装备差距。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1938, late in the Xuzhou campaign, Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division around Lanfeng. Chinese troops briefly recovered Lanfeng, but as Japanese reinforcements approached and threatened their flank and rear, they were forced to withdraw. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign and exposed gaps in command coordination and equipment. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

fields.name: 武汉失守 Fall of Wuhan 武汉会战 Battle of Wuhan 武汉保卫战 Defense of Wuhan
fields.summary: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。 After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月起，日军沿长江南北进攻武汉。中国军队组织武汉会战，激战数月后于 10 月撤出。10 月 25 日武汉失守，国民政府机关此前已迁往重庆，抗日战争逐步进入战略相持阶段。 本事件为路线相关节点，日期与表述待史料校订。 From June 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Wuhan from both sides of the Yangtze. Chinese troops fought the Battle of Wuhan for months before withdrawing in October. Wuhan fell on 25 October; government organs had already moved to Chongqing, and the war gradually entered a phase of strategic stalemate. This event is linked to route segments; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1939 年 5 月，日军第 11 军向随县、枣阳地区进攻，企图打击中国第五战区主力。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，并在日军补给困难时反击，至 5 月下旬恢复原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后的重要作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1939, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas, seeking to strike the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone. Chinese troops used the terrain to resist in stages and counterattacked as Japanese supply lines became strained, restoring the original line by late May. It was an important operation after the war entered the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 湖南新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。
summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.

fields.name: 昆仑关战役 Battle of Kunlun Pass 昆仑关大捷 Kunlun Pass Victory
fields.place: 广西南宁昆仑关 Kunlun Pass, Nanning, Guangxi
fields.summary: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。 Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月，中国军队为收复南宁、夺回昆仑关，对日军发起反攻。中国第 5 军等部在昆仑关与日军激战，反复争夺，最终于 1940 年 1 月收复昆仑关，击毙日军旅团长中村正雄。此役是抗战中期中国军队的一次重要攻坚胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In December 1939, Chinese forces launched a counteroffensive to recover Nanning and retake Kunlun Pass. The Chinese 5th Army and other units fought fierce, seesaw battles against the Japanese at the pass, finally recapturing it in January 1940 and killing the Japanese brigade commander Nakamura Masao. It was an important Chinese offensive victory in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 枣宜会战 Battle of Zaoyang–Yichang 枣宜战役 Zaoyi Campaign
fields.summary: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。 Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 百团大战 Hundred Regiments Offensive 百团战役 Hundred Regiments Campaign 正太路破袭战 Zhengding–Taiyuan Railway Sabotage

fields.summary: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，打击日军交通线与据点。 The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign against Japanese transport lines and strongpoints in North China.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达一百余个团。战役持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也引起日军对华北敌后根据地的更残酷“扫荡”。 本事件日期、地点与规模表述待史料校订。 Beginning on 20 August 1940, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, with more than a hundred regiments eventually taking part. The campaign lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese transport lines and strongpoints and prompting harsher Japanese “mopping-up” operations against base areas. Dates, location, and scale await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 上高会战 Battle of Shanggao 上高大捷 Shanggao Victory
fields.summary: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。 Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 3 月，日军第十一军向江西上高地区进攻，企图打击中国第九战区部队。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，诱敌深入后实施包围反击，至 4 月上旬收复失地，取得上高会战胜利。此役是抗战中期正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In March 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Shanggao area of Jiangxi, seeking to strike Chinese forces of the Ninth War Zone. Chinese troops resisted in stages using the terrain, drew the Japanese in, then counterattacked and encircled them, recovering the lost ground by early April and winning the Battle of Shanggao. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。 Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 中国对日宣战 China Declares War on Japan
fields.summary: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。 After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1941, the Chinese National Government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy and annulled all treaties, agreements, and contracts with them. China’s resistance became more closely integrated into the global anti-fascist alliance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。
summary.en: Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 第三次长沙会战 Third Battle of Changsha 长沙大捷 Changsha Victory 第三次长沙战役 Third Changsha Campaign
fields.summary: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。 Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1942 年初，为保卫滇缅公路和支援盟军，中国远征军陆续自云南入缅，与英军协同作战。远征军在缅北、缅中地区与日军激战，后因战局不利而撤退。 本事件日期取 1942 年 2 月的示意时间点，具体入缅日期待史料校订。 In early 1942, to defend the Burma Road and support the Allies, the Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan and fought alongside British troops. It engaged Japanese forces in northern and central Burma before withdrawing under unfavorable conditions. The date is an illustrative point in February 1942; the exact entry dates await historical review.

fields.summary: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。 After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.
fields.description: 1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。 本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。 Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India. The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.

fields.name: 鄂西会战 Battle of West Hubei 石牌保卫战 Defense of Shipai
fields.place: 湖北宜昌石牌 Shipai, Yichang, Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。 Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.
fields.description: 1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.

fields.name: 常德会战 Battle of Changde 常德保卫战 Defense of Changde
fields.summary: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。 Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

fields.name: 开罗会议 Cairo Conference
fields.summary: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。 Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。 本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China. This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。 本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.name: 滇西反攻 Western Yunnan Counteroffensive 滇西缅北反攻 Yunnan–Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国远征军强渡怒江，反攻腾冲、龙陵、松山，至 1945 年初收复滇西。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月，中国远征军强渡怒江，向腾冲、龙陵、松山等地日军发起反攻。中国军队与盟军协同，经过松山、腾冲、龙陵等激战，至 1945 年 1 月收复畹町，打通中印公路。此役是抗战后期中国军队在滇西的重要反攻，与缅北反攻相互配合。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and launched a counteroffensive against Japanese forces at Tengchong, Longling, Songshan, and other points. Working with Allied forces, Chinese troops fought fierce battles at Songshan, Tengchong, and Longling, recovered Wanding in January 1945, and opened the Ledo Road. The campaign was an important Chinese counteroffensive in western Yunnan in the later war years, coordinated with the northern Burma offensive. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 松山战役 Battle of Songshan 松山攻坚战 Songshan Offensive
fields.place: 云南龙陵松山 Songshan, Longling, Yunnan
fields.summary: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。 本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。 From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road. Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

summary.en: The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.

fields.name: 衡阳保卫战 Defense of Hengyang 衡阳会战 Hengyang Campaign
fields.summary: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。 The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。 In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 南宁失守 Fall of Nanning
fields.summary: 日军在豫湘桂战役中占领南宁，打通大陆交通线的企图一度得逞。 Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.
fields.description: 1944 年 11 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中继续南犯，11 月 24 日占领南宁。日军企图打通从华北到印度支那的大陆交通线，但战线过长、兵力分散，难以长期巩固。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 In November 1944, Japanese forces continued south during Operation Ichi-Go and captured Nanning on 24 November. Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.

fields.name: 湘西会战 Battle of West Hunan 雪峰山会战 Battle of Xuefeng Mountains
fields.summary: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。 Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月，日军发动湘西会战，企图破坏芷江空军基地。中国军队依托雪峰山地形顽强抵抗并反击，至 6 月收复失地，日军伤亡惨重。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要胜利，也是日本投降前中国军队的最后一次大规模攻势防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In April 1945, Japanese forces launched the Battle of West Hunan in an attempt to destroy the Zhijiang air base. Chinese troops used the terrain of the Xuefeng Mountains to resist stubbornly and counterattack, recovering the lost ground by June and inflicting heavy casualties on the Japanese. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the final year of the war and one of the Chinese army’s last large-scale defensive-offensive operations before Japan’s surrender. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1945 年 5 月起，中国军队在广西发起局部反攻，逐步收复豫湘桂战役中失守的城镇。随着日本宣布投降，桂柳、南宁等地相继光复。 本事件日期为示意时间点，具体作战进程待史料校订。 From May 1945, Chinese forces launched a limited counteroffensive in Guangxi, gradually recovering towns lost during Operation Ichi-Go. With Japan’s announcement of surrender, Guilin, Liuzhou, Nanning, and other places were recovered. The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

fields.summary: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。 The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 6 日，美国在日本广岛投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美国又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 6 August 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, causing massive casualties. On 9 August, another bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.

fields.summary: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

fields.name: 日本宣布无条件投降 Japan Announces Unconditional Surrender
fields.summary: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。 The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended. This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

fields.summary: 国民党军在汝城—城口间构筑第二道封锁线，红军于 11 月 5—8 日突破。 KMT forces built the second blockade line between Rucheng and Chengkou; the Red Army broke through on 5–8 November.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月初，蒋介石令湘军何键、粤军陈济棠在湖南汝城至广东城口间构筑第二道封锁线，以碉堡群控制湘粤通道。11 月 1 日，中革军委令红一军团夺取城口、红三军团夺取汝城；红一军团第二师第六团第一营急行军 220 余里，于 11 月 2 日夜袭占城口；汝城守敌较多，红军以一部监视，主力于 11 月 5 日从汝城、城口间分三路通过，至 11 月 8 日全部突破封锁线。本坐标为汝城—城口间代表点，具体碉堡线待考。 In early November 1934, Chiang Kai-shek ordered He Jian’s Hunan troops and Chen Jitang’s Guangdong troops to build the second blockade line between Rucheng in Hunan and Chengkou in Guangdong, using blockhouses to control the Hunan–Guangdong corridor. On 1 November the CMC ordered the First Army Corps to take Chengkou and the Third Army Corps to take Rucheng. The 1st Battalion of the 6th Regiment, Second Division, marched over 220 li and seized Chengkou by night on 2 November. Rucheng was too strongly held, so the Red Army monitored it and moved the main force through the Rucheng–Chengkou gap in three columns from 5 November, completing the breakthrough by 8 November. The coordinate is a representative point between Rucheng and Chengkou; the exact blockhouse line awaits verification.

fields.summary: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。 Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。湘军刘建绪部由全州南下，桂军由兴安、灌阳北上，企图在湘江以东夹击红军。红军在屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口和新圩、脚山铺、光华铺等阻击阵地与敌激战，最终突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1934, Kuomintang forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops drove south from Quanzhou while Guangxi troops moved north from Xing’an and Guanyang, seeking to crush the Red Army east of the river. The Red Army fought at the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries and at the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking positions before breaking through at heavy cost. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中央红军在兴安、全州、灌阳间强渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，由八万余人锐减至三万余人。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang, breaking the fourth blockade line and falling from over 80,000 to about 30,000 troops.

fields.name: 湘江战役 Battle of the Xiang River 湘江血战 Battle of the Xiang River 突破第四道封锁线 Breaking the Fourth Blockade Line
fields.place: 广西兴安界首渡口（湘江战役主渡口） Jieshou Ferry, Xing’an, Guangxi (main crossing of the Xiang River battle)
fields.summary: 中央红军在兴安、全州、灌阳间强渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，由八万余人锐减至三万余人。 The Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang, breaking the fourth blockade line and falling from over 80,000 to about 30,000 troops.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 12 月 1 日，中央红军在广西兴安、全州、灌阳之间的湘江上游抢渡，突破国民党军第四道封锁线。红军先后控制屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口，以新圩、脚山铺、光华铺三大阻击战掩护中央纵队渡江。11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日，军委第一、第二纵队从界首浮桥渡江；红五、红八、红九军团等部则在下游凤凰嘴涉渡。12 月 1 日下午界首浮桥被炸毁，担任后卫的红五军团第三十四师、红三军团第十八团被阻于湘江以东，损失惨重。此役后中央红军由出发时的八万余人锐减至三万余人。 From 27 November to 1 December 1934, the Central Red Army crossed the upper Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang in Guangxi, breaking the Kuomintang’s fourth blockade line. The Red Army controlled the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries in succession and used the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking battles to cover the crossing of the central column. On 30 November and 1 December, the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over the Jieshou pontoon bridge, while the Fifth, Eighth, and Ninth Army Corps forded downstream at Fenghuangzui. When the Jieshou bridge was blown up on the afternoon of 1 December, the rearguard Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps and the Eighteenth Regiment of the Third Army Corps were cut off east of the river and suffered heavy losses. The Central Red Army fell from more than 80,000 troops at the start of the Long March to about 30,000.

place.zh: 广西灌阳水车镇（灌江沿岸）
place.en: Shuiche, Guanyang, Guangxi (along the Guan River)

summary.zh: 红五军团第三十四师担任全军总后卫，在道县蒋家岭至灌阳水车一线节节阻击，12 月 1 日被阻于湘江东岸。
summary.en: The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps served as the army’s final rearguard, fighting delaying actions from Jiangjialing in Daoxian to Shuiche in Guanyang before being cut off east of the Xiang River on 1 December.

fields.name: 红三十四师后卫阻击 Thirty-Fourth Division Rearguard Action 红三十四师绝命后卫 Thirty-Fourth Division’s Desperate Rearguard 水车阻击战 Shuiche Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西灌阳水车镇（灌江沿岸） Shuiche, Guanyang, Guangxi (along the Guan River)
fields.summary: 红五军团第三十四师担任全军总后卫，在道县蒋家岭至灌阳水车一线节节阻击，12 月 1 日被阻于湘江东岸。 The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps served as the army’s final rearguard, fighting delaying actions from Jiangjialing in Daoxian to Shuiche in Guanyang before being cut off east of the Xiang River on 1 December.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 29 日，红五军团第三十四师奉命在湖南道县蒋家岭、永安关、雷口关一线节节阻击追敌，掩护红八、红九军团西进。29 日 15 时，中革军委电令该师赶赴灌阳新圩接防，30 日晨在水车一带掩护红八军团离开灌阳，随即遭桂军飞机轰炸和地面进攻。12 月 1 日，该师由水车赶往枫树脚接防时，渡口和道路已被切断，全师被阻于湘江东岸。此后经全州安和文塘、灌阳板桥铺等地突围，损失惨重，余部转战湘南。本坐标为水车镇代表点，具体阵地范围待实地核对。 From 27 to 29 November 1934, the Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps fought delaying actions at Jiangjialing, Yong’an Pass, and Leikou Pass in Daoxian, Hunan, covering the westward movement of the Eighth and Ninth Army Corps. At 15:00 on 29 November the Military Commission ordered the division to relieve the defenses at Xinxu, Guanyang. At dawn on 30 November it covered the Eighth Army Corps’ departure from Guanyang at Shuiche, then came under air attack and ground assault by Guangxi troops. On 1 December, as the division moved from Shuiche toward Fengshujiao, the ferries and roads were already cut, leaving the whole division stranded east of the Xiang River. It subsequently broke out through Wentang in Anhe, Quanzhou, and Banqiaopu in Guanyang at heavy cost, with survivors continuing to fight in southern Hunan. This coordinate is the representative point of Shuiche town; the exact position of the defensive line awaits field verification.

place.en: Between Daping Village, Fenghuang, and Luokou Village, Shaoshui, Quanzhou, Guangxi

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团主力最早由此渡过湘江，被称为“突破湘江第一渡”。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the main force of the First Army Corps made the earliest crossing, known as the “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.”

fields.name: 大坪渡口 Daping Ferry 大坪古渡 Daping Ancient Ferry 红军长征突破湘江第一渡 First Ferry of the Xiang River Breakthrough
fields.place: 广西全州凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间 Between Daping Village, Fenghuang, and Luokou Village, Shaoshui, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团主力最早由此渡过湘江，被称为“突破湘江第一渡”。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the main force of the First Army Corps made the earliest crossing, known as the “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.”
fields.description: 大坪渡口位于全州县凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间的湘江上，东岸为大坪村，西岸为洛口村，是全州历史上的古渡。1934 年 11 月 27 日凌晨，红一军团第二师及红一师第二团趁桂军南撤之机，从大坪渡口渡过湘江，成为湘江战役中最早过江的红军部队，因此被称为“红军长征突破湘江第一渡”。随后红一军团控制了屏山至界首约 30 公里的湘江渡口。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Daping Ferry crosses the Xiang River between Daping Village in Fenghuang and Luokou Village in Shaoshui, Quanzhou. In the early hours of 27 November 1934, the Second Division of the First Army Corps and the Second Regiment of the First Division crossed here while Guangxi troops were withdrawing south, making them the earliest Red Army units across the Xiang River and earning the site the name “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.” The First Army Corps then controlled the ferries along some 30 km of river from Pingshan to Jieshou. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

place.en: Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi (Fengshujiao, Banqiaopu, and Jiuhaijing area)

summary.zh: 红三军团第五师在新圩阻击北上桂军，是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战。
summary.en: The Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Xinxu, the first of the three major blocking battles of the Xiang River campaign.

fields.name: 新圩阻击战 Xinxu Blocking Battle 新圩阻击战（灌阳） Xinxu Blocking Battle (Guanyang) 枫树脚阻击战 Fengshujiao Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西灌阳新圩镇（枫树脚、板桥铺、酒海井一带） Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi (Fengshujiao, Banqiaopu, and Jiuhaijing area)
fields.summary: 红三军团第五师在新圩阻击北上桂军，是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战。 The Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Xinxu, the first of the three major blocking battles of the Xiang River campaign.
fields.description: 新圩位于灌阳县西北部，是灌阳通往湘江的必经之路。1934 年 11 月 28 日拂晓，红三军团第五师在新圩、枫树脚、板桥铺一线阻击北上的桂军，战斗持续三天，伤亡 2000 余人；红六师第十八团接防后大部牺牲。新圩阻击战是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战，保住了中央红军前往湘江渡口的通道。现建有新圩阻击战酒海井红军纪念园。 Xinxu lies in northwestern Guanyang on the route from Guanyang to the Xiang River. At dawn on 28 November 1934, the Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked the northward advance of Guangxi troops at Xinxu, Fengshujiao, and Banqiaopu. The three-day battle cost more than 2,000 casualties; the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, which took over the position, was largely destroyed. As the first of the three major blocking battles, Xinxu kept open the Central Red Army’s route to the Xiang River ferries. The Xinxu Blocking Battle Jiuhai Well Red Army Memorial Park now stands nearby.

place.zh: 广西全州才湾镇脚山铺（觉山铺）

summary.zh: 红一军团在脚山铺阻击南下湘军，是湘江战役中投入兵力最多、红军牺牲最大的阻击战。
summary.en: The First Army Corps blocked the southward advance of Hunan troops at Jiaoshanpu, the largest and costliest blocking battle of the Xiang River campaign.

fields.name: 脚山铺阻击战 Jiaoshanpu Blocking Battle 觉山铺阻击战 Jueshanpu Blocking Battle 脚山阻击战 Jiaoshan Blocking Battle
fields.place: 广西全州才湾镇脚山铺（觉山铺） Jiaoshanpu (Jueshanpu), Caiwan, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 红一军团在脚山铺阻击南下湘军，是湘江战役中投入兵力最多、红军牺牲最大的阻击战。 The First Army Corps blocked the southward advance of Hunan troops at Jiaoshanpu, the largest and costliest blocking battle of the Xiang River campaign.
fields.description: 脚山铺又称觉山铺，位于全州县才湾镇，北距全州城约 15 公里，南距界首渡口约 30 公里，桂黄公路穿山而过。1934 年 11 月 29 日起，红一军团第二师及第一师在脚山铺、鲁板桥、白沙河一线阻击湘军刘建绪部。战斗持续三天，红一军团伤亡约 2000 人，红五团政委易荡平牺牲，完成了掩护中央纵队和后续部队渡江的任务。现地建有红军长征湘江战役纪念园、纪念馆。 Jiaoshanpu, also written Jueshanpu, lies in Caiwan, Quanzhou, about 15 km from Quanzhou town and 30 km from Jieshou Ferry, where the Guilin–Huangshahe road cuts through the hills. From 29 November 1934, the Second Division and First Division of the First Army Corps blocked Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops along the Jiaoshanpu, Lubanqiao, and Baisha River line. The three-day battle cost the First Army Corps about 2,000 casualties, including the death of Fifth Regiment commissar Yi Dangping, but covered the crossing of the central column and follow-up units. The Red Army Long March Xiang River Battle Memorial Park and Museum now stand at the site.

place.en: Guanghuapu south of Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi (beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road)

summary.zh: 红三军团第四师在光华铺阻击北上桂军，保卫界首渡口，红十团两任团长先后牺牲。
summary.en: The Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Guanghuapu to protect Jieshou Ferry; two successive commanders of the Tenth Regiment were killed.

fields.name: 光华铺阻击战 Guanghuapu Blocking Battle 界首阻击战 Jieshou Blocking Battle 光华铺阻击战旧址 Guanghuapu Blocking Battle Site
fields.place: 广西兴安界首镇南光华铺（桂黄公路旁） Guanghuapu south of Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi (beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road)
fields.summary: 红三军团第四师在光华铺阻击北上桂军，保卫界首渡口，红十团两任团长先后牺牲。 The Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Guanghuapu to protect Jieshou Ferry; two successive commanders of the Tenth Regiment were killed.
fields.description: 光华铺位于兴安县界首镇南约 3 至 5 公里、桂黄公路旁，是界首渡口的南面屏障。1934 年 11 月 28 日红三军团第四师接防界首后，以第十团前出光华铺，阻击由兴安北上的桂军。29 日夜间至 12 月 1 日，双方在光华铺、渠口、石门一线反复争夺，红十团团长沈述清、师参谋长杜中美先后牺牲，红三军团伤亡约 1000 人，掩护军委纵队从界首渡江。 Guanghuapu lies about 3–5 km south of Jieshou, Xing’an, beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road, and formed the southern shield of Jieshou Ferry. After the Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps took over the Jieshou defenses on 28 November 1934, it pushed the Tenth Regiment forward to Guanghuapu to block Guangxi troops advancing north from Xing’an. From the night of 29 November to 1 December, the two sides fought repeatedly over Guanghuapu, Qukou, and Shimen. Tenth Regiment commander Shen Shuqing and corps chief of staff Du Zhongmei were killed in succession, and the Third Army Corps suffered about 1,000 casualties while covering the crossing of the Military Commission’s columns at Jieshou.

name.en: Eighteenth Regiment’s Blocking Action at Xinxu

place.zh: 广西灌阳新圩镇楠木山村、陈家背一带
place.en: Nanmushan and Chenjiabei, Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi

summary.zh: 红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩楠木山接防，以一团之众阻击桂军数个师，几乎全部牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, took over at Nanmushan near Xinxu and blocked several Guangxi divisions with a single regiment, suffering near-total losses.

fields.name: 红十八团新圩阻击 Eighteenth Regiment’s Blocking Action at Xinxu 楠木山阻击战 Nanmushan Blocking Battle 红十八团楠木山战斗 Eighteenth Regiment at Nanmushan
fields.place: 广西灌阳新圩镇楠木山村、陈家背一带 Nanmushan and Chenjiabei, Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi
fields.summary: 红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩楠木山接防，以一团之众阻击桂军数个师，几乎全部牺牲。 The Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, took over at Nanmushan near Xinxu and blocked several Guangxi divisions with a single regiment, suffering near-total losses.
fields.description: 1934 年 11 月 30 日黄昏，红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩接替伤亡惨重的红五师，担负阻击桂军、掩护后续部队渡江的任务。据国防部报道，团长曾春鉴、参谋长吴子雄决定以两个营扼守楠木山村附近的炮楼山，一个营布防陈家背；另有资料称团长姓名至今未查清。12 月 1 日拂晓，桂军向楠木山阵地猛攻，红军弹药耗尽后展开白刃格斗。炮楼山失守后，部队向陈家背靠拢，又在向湘江转移途中被分割包围于全州古岭头一带，1800 余人大部分牺牲。本坐标为楠木山村附近代表点，具体阵地待实地核对。 At dusk on 30 November 1934, the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, relieved the badly mauled Fifth Division at Xinxu and took over the task of blocking Guangxi troops to cover the crossing of follow-up units. According to the Ministry of National Defense account, commander Zeng Chunjian and chief of staff Wu Zixiong deployed two battalions on Paolou Hill near Nanmushan and one battalion at Chenjiabei; other sources state that the commander’s name has never been established. At dawn on 1 December, Guangxi troops stormed the Nanmushan positions, and the Red Army, its ammunition exhausted, fought hand to hand. After Paolou Hill fell the unit fell back toward Chenjiabei and was then surrounded and split apart near Gulingtou in Quanzhou while moving toward the Xiang River; most of its more than 1,800 men were killed. This coordinate is a representative point near Nanmushan village; the exact positions await field verification.

summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the First Division of the First Army Corps crossed to reach Jiaoshanpu.

fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团第一师由此渡过湘江赶赴脚山铺。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the First Division of the First Army Corps crossed to reach Jiaoshanpu.
fields.description: 屏山渡口位于全州县枧塘镇金屏村屏山屯湘江两岸，距全州城约 10 公里，渡口宽约 500 米，南北两岸为石山，下游有拦河堰可涉渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，红一军团第一师从湖南道县急行军赶到，由屏山渡渡过湘江，与从大坪渡江的红二师在脚山铺会合，参加阻击湘军的战斗。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Pingshan Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Pingshan, Jinping Village, Jiantang, Quanzhou, about 10 km from Quanzhou town. The ferry is about 500 m wide, flanked by rocky hills, with a downstream weir that can be forded. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Division of the First Army Corps arrived from Daoxian in Hunan by forced march, crossed at Pingshan, and joined the Second Division at Jiaoshanpu to block the Hunan troops. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

summary.en: The main crossing of the Xiang River battle, where the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge on 30 November–1 December.

fields.summary: 湘江战役主渡口，军委第一、第二纵队于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日由浮桥渡过湘江。 The main crossing of the Xiang River battle, where the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge on 30 November–1 December.
fields.description: 界首渡口位于兴安县界首镇湘江边，与全州县相邻，是湘江上游的重要古渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，军委第一纵队在工兵架设的浮桥上游过湘江；第二纵队随红三军团行动，当日黄昏渡江。12 月 1 日下午，工兵奉命炸毁浮桥。渡口西岸的三官堂（红军堂）曾是红军渡江指挥部，彭德怀、朱德、周恩来等在此指挥渡江与阻击战。 Jieshou Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Jieshou, Xing’an, near the border with Quanzhou, and was an important ancient crossing on the upper Xiang. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Column of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge built by engineers; the Second Column, moving with the Third Army Corps, crossed at dusk that day. On the afternoon of 1 December, engineers blew up the bridge on orders. Sanguantang (Red Army Hall) on the west bank served as the crossing command post, where Peng Dehuai, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai directed the crossing and blocking battles.

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，也是红军牺牲最多的渡口；界首浮桥被炸后，后续部队改由此涉渡。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle and the crossing with the heaviest Red Army casualties; follow-up units forded here after the Jieshou bridge was destroyed.

fields.name: 凤凰嘴渡口 Fenghuangzui Ferry 麻子渡 Mazidu Ferry 建安司渡口 Jian’ansi Ferry
fields.place: 广西全州凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边 Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, Guangxi
fields.summary: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，也是红军牺牲最多的渡口；界首浮桥被炸后，后续部队改由此涉渡。 One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle and the crossing with the heaviest Red Army casualties; follow-up units forded here after the Jieshou bridge was destroyed.
fields.description: 凤凰嘴渡口位于全州县凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边，又名麻子渡，与上游约 10 公里的界首渡口隔江相望。1934 年 12 月 1 日，界首浮桥被炸毁后，红九军团、红五军团第十三师、红八军团等部改由凤凰嘴渡口及下游董家堰涉渡。渡口江面开阔、两岸无遮蔽，红军遭敌机轰炸和追兵射击，伤亡惨重，是湘江战役中牺牲最多的渡口。1934 年 9 月红六军团西征时也曾在此渡过湘江。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。 Fenghuangzui Ferry, also called Mazidu, lies on the Xiang River at Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, about 10 km downstream of Jieshou. On 1 December 1934, after the Jieshou pontoon bridge was destroyed, the Ninth Army Corps, the Thirteenth Division of the Fifth Army Corps, the Eighth Army Corps, and other units forded here and at the Dongjiayan weir downstream. The open river and exposed banks left the Red Army vulnerable to air attack and pursuing fire, making this the deadliest crossing of the campaign. The Sixth Army Corps had also crossed here during its westward expedition in September 1934. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

fields.description: 1934 年 12 月 10 日，红二十五军在陕西洛南县庾家河与国民党军激战，军长程子华、副军长徐海东负伤。番号与伤情为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On December 10, 1934, the Red 25th Army fought a fierce battle with KMT forces at Yujiahe, Luonan, Shaanxi; commander Cheng Zihua and deputy commander Xu Haidong were wounded. fields.description: 1934 年 12 月，红三十四师完成掩护主力渡江后折返湘南。12 月 10 日，师长陈树湘在江华牯子江渡口战斗中腹部重伤；12 日，余部在道县四马桥早和田遭伏，陈树湘与警卫员在馒头岭冯督庙（洪都庙）附近被俘。12 月 18 日上午，道县保安团将其押往县城，行至蚣坝镇石马神村麒麟庙休息时，陈树湘趁敌不备，从腹部伤口绞断肠子，壮烈牺牲，年仅 29 岁。本坐标为石马神村代表点，麒麟庙遗址具体位置待实测。 In December 1934, after covering the main force’s crossing, the Thirty-Fourth Division turned back toward southern Hunan. On 10 December commander Chen Shuxiang was gravely wounded in the abdomen at the Guzijiang ferry in Jianghua; on 12 December the remnants were ambushed at Zaohetian near Simaqiao, Daoxian, and Chen and his guards were captured near Fengdu Temple (Hongdu Temple) at Mantouling. On the morning of 18 December, as the Daoxian security regiment carried him toward the county town, the party stopped to rest at Qilin Temple in Shimashen Village, Gongba. Chen seized the moment, tore open his abdominal wound, and died aged 29. This coordinate is a representative point for Shimashen village; the exact site of Qilin Temple awaits field verification.

It reaffirmed the Liping decision and required major military actions to be discussed by the Political Bureau.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月，黔军第 25 军副军长兼教导师师长侯之担部在乌江北岸茶山关、孙家渡、江界河、袁家渡、回龙场等 10 余处渡口部署 5 个团又 1 个机炮营，防线长约 200 里，并毁船、拆房、构筑工事，企图阻止红军北渡。红军分三路从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口突破，至 1 月 6 日全部渡江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点，防线沿乌江展开。 In January 1935, Hou Zhidan, deputy commander of the Guizhou 25th Army and commander of the training division, deployed five regiments and one machine-gun/artillery battalion at more than ten ferries on the north bank of the Wu River, including Chashanguan, Sunjiadu, Jiangjiehe, Yuanjiadu, and Huilongchang. The line was about 200 li long; the defenders destroyed boats, demolished houses, and built fortifications to block the Red Army. The Red Army broke through at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, Chashanguan, and other ferries, crossing completely by 6 January. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry; the line extended along the Wu River.

fields.name: 强渡乌江 Forcing the Wu River
fields.place: 贵州瓮安江界河渡口 Jiangjiehe Ferry, Weng’an, Guizhou
fields.summary: 中央红军从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口强渡乌江，进占遵义。 The Central Red Army forced the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, and Chashanguan and advanced on Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日至 6 日，中央红军分三路强渡乌江：红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团在江界河、红 1 师第 1 团在回龙场、红 3 军团在茶山关等渡口渡江。红军以竹筏、浮桥突破黔军侯之担部防线，击溃黔军 4 个团、2 个营约 4000 人，至 6 日全部渡过乌江，进占遵义。此役是长征以来第一个较大胜利，为遵义会议召开创造了条件。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。 From 1 to 6 January 1935 the Central Red Army crossed the Wu River in three routes: the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, at Jiangjiehe; the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division at Huilongchang; and the Third Army Corps at Chashanguan and other ferries. Using bamboo rafts and pontoon bridges, the Red Army broke the defense line of Hou Zhidan’s Guizhou troops, routed four regiments and two battalions (about 4,000 men), and by 6 January had crossed the river and entered Zunyi. It was the first major victory since the Long March began and created conditions for the Zunyi Conference. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 1 师第 1 团在团长杨得志、政委黎林率领下进至回龙场渡口，8 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡被巨浪吞没。2 日深夜，红军在鱼子塘等水势较缓处强渡成功，击溃北岸黔军一个营；3 日凌晨架设浮桥，至 4 日红 1 军团主力及红 9 军团渡江完毕。本坐标为回龙场渡口代表点。 On 1 January 1935 the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division, First Army Corps, under Yang Dezhi and political commissar Li Lin, reached Huilongchang Ferry; eight men on a bamboo raft were lost in the waves. Late on 2 January the Red Army crossed successfully at calmer points such as Yuzitang, routed a Guizhou battalion on the north bank, and built a pontoon bridge before dawn on 3 January; by 4 January the main force of the First Army Corps and the 9th Army Corps had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Huilongchang Ferry.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团进至江界河渡口，耿飚、杨成武侦察后决定佯攻老渡口、主攻上游新渡口。1 月 2 日，毛振华率 7 名勇士泅渡失败；夜间 18 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡，5 人潜伏北岸。3 日拂晓，60 余只竹筏在火力掩护下强渡，毛振华等 5 人从敌后接应，红军占领北岸，工兵架起浮桥，军委纵队与红 5 军团由此过江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。 On 1 January 1935 the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, reached Jiangjiehe Ferry. After reconnaissance, Geng Biao and Yang Chengwu decided to feint at the old ferry and attack the upper new ferry. On 2 January Mao Zhenhua led seven men in a failed swim; that night eighteen men crossed by bamboo raft, with five hiding on the north bank. At dawn on 3 January more than sixty rafts crossed under fire while Mao and his five men attacked from the rear, seizing the north bank. Engineers built a pontoon bridge, and the CMC column and 5th Army Corps crossed there. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.

fields.summary: 红 3 军团在茶山关渡口渡江，守敌不战而逃。 The Third Army Corps crossed at Chashanguan; the defenders fled without a fight.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 3 日，红 3 军团第 4 师第 10 团进至茶山关渡口，守敌刘翰吾部在得知回龙场、江界河失守后连夜弃阵逃回遵义。红军在当地船工协助下捞起沉船、架设浮桥，1 月 4 日至 6 日红 3 军团分别从桃子台、茶山关、楠木渡渡过乌江，进入遵义尚嵇一带。本坐标为茶山关渡口代表点。 On 3 January 1935 the 10th Regiment of the 4th Division, Third Army Corps, reached Chashanguan Ferry. After learning that Huilongchang and Jiangjiehe had fallen, Liu Hanwu’s defenders abandoned their positions and fled to Zunyi. With local boatmen the Red Army raised sunken boats and built a pontoon bridge; from 4 to 6 January the Third Army Corps crossed at Taozitai, Chashanguan, and Nanmudu and entered the Shangji area of Zunyi. The coordinate is a representative point at Chashanguan Ferry.

summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

fields.name: 遵义会议 Zunyi meeting 遵义政治局扩大会议 Zunyi Politburo Enlarged Meeting
fields.summary: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。 Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。 From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 28 日，中央红军在贵州习水土城地区与川军郭勋祺部激战，因敌情判断有误未能取胜，随即西渡赤水河。 On January 28, 1935, the Central Red Army fought Guo Xunqi’s Sichuan troops at Tucheng, Xishui, Guizhou. After failing to win because of a misjudgment of enemy strength, it crossed the Chishui River to the west.

fields.summary: 红军从土城、元厚西渡赤水河，进入川南。 The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Tucheng and Yuanhou and enters southern Sichuan.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 28 日土城青杠坡战斗失利后，中革军委决定放弃在赤水—泸州间北渡长江的计划，改从土城、元厚西渡赤水河。29 日拂晓，红军从土城浑溪口、蔡家沱和元厚沙沱、川祖庙等渡口渡过赤水河，进入四川古蔺、叙永地区，随后转进云南扎西集结。 After the setback at Qinggangpo on 28 January 1935, the Central Revolutionary Military Commission abandoned the plan to cross the Yangtze near Chishui–Luzhou and ordered a westward crossing at Tucheng and Yuanhou. At dawn on 29 January, the Red Army crossed at Hunxikou and Caijiatuo near Tucheng and at Shatuo and Chuanzumiao near Yuanhou, entered Gulin and Xuyong in Sichuan, and then moved to Zhaxi in Yunnan.

fields.name: 扎西会议 Zhaxi Meeting 扎西政治局扩大会议 Zhaxi Enlarged Politburo Meeting 水田寨—大河滩—扎西会议 Shuitianzhai–Dahetan–Zhaxi Meetings
fields.place: 云南威信扎西镇 Zhaxi, Weixin, Yunnan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在威信水田寨、大河滩、扎西镇连续开会，完成遵义会议未及完成的任务。 The Politburo met successively at Shuitianzhai, Dahetan, and Zhaxi in Weixin, completing tasks left unfinished at Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 5 日至 9 日，中央政治局在云南威信水田寨花房子、大河滩庄子上、扎西镇江西会馆连续召开会议，统称扎西会议。会议决定由张闻天代替博古负总责，毛泽东为周恩来军事指挥上的帮助者；通过《遵义会议决议》；决定暂缓北渡长江、回师东进、二渡赤水；缩编中央红军为 16 个团（加干部团 17 个团）；成立中共川南特委和红军川南游击纵队。本坐标为扎西镇代表点，水田寨、大河滩会址待分别落位。 From 5 to 9 February 1935, the Politburo met successively at the Huafangzi in Shuitianzhai, the Zhuangzishang in Dahetan, and the Jiangxi Guild Hall in Zhaxi, Weixin, Yunnan; the meetings are collectively known as the Zhaxi Meeting. They decided that Zhang Wentian should replace Bo Gu as overall leader and that Mao Zedong should assist Zhou Enlai in military command; adopted the Zunyi Conference Resolution; decided to postpone the Yangtze crossing, return east, and cross the Chishui River a second time; reduced the Central Red Army to 16 regiments (17 with the Cadre Regiment); and established the South Sichuan Special Committee and the Red Army South Sichuan Guerrilla Column. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhaxi; the Shuitianzhai and Dahetan sites await separate placement.

fields.summary: 红军由太平渡、九溪口、二郎滩、淋滩东渡赤水河，回师黔北。 The Red Army crosses the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, Erlangtan, and Lintan and returns to northern Guizhou.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 18 日至 21 日，中央红军分路从太平渡、九溪口、老鸹沱、二郎滩、淋滩等渡口东渡赤水河，重入黔北，随后攻占桐梓、娄山关，再占遵义。太平渡是渡口群，包含太平渡口、上游约 5 公里的九溪口和下游约 1 里的老鸹沱（老鹰石）。 From 18 to 21 February 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River eastward in several columns at Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, Laoguatuo, Erlangtan, and Lintan, re-entered northern Guizhou, captured Tongzi and Loushan Pass, and retook Zunyi. Taipingdu was a ferry group that included Taipingdu proper, Jiuxikou about 5 km upstream, and Laoguatuo (Laoyingshi) about 0.5 km downstream.

fields.description: 老鸹沱又称老鹰石，位于太平渡下游约 1 里。1935 年 2 月 19 日至 20 日，红军在太平渡、老鹰石、九溪口、二郎滩等渡口架设浮桥东渡；3 月 21 日至 22 日再次由此东渡。具体桥址待实测。 Laoguatuo, also called Laoyingshi, lies about 0.5 km downstream of Taipingdu. On 19–20 February 1935, the Red Army built pontoon bridges at Taipingdu, Laoyingshi, Jiuxikou, and Erlangtan and crossed eastward; it crossed here again on 21–22 March. The exact bridge site awaits field verification.

fields.place: 四川古蔺二郎滩（赤水河川黔交界） Erlangtan, Gulin, Sichuan (Chishui River border between Sichuan and Guizhou)
fields.summary: 二渡、四渡赤水的主要渡口，红军在此进行二郎滩背水战。 A main ferry of the second and fourth Chishui crossings, where the Red Army fought the Erlangtan back-to-the-river battle.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 19 日，红三军团第十三团在二郎滩以三条小船强渡，随后架设浮桥；3 月 21 日至 22 日，红九军团等部再次由此东渡赤水河。二郎滩渡口为全国重点文物保护单位。 On 19 February 1935, the 13th Regiment of the Third Army Corps crossed by force in three small boats at Erlangtan and then built a pontoon bridge; on 21–22 March, the Ninth Army Corps and other units crossed eastward here again. The Erlangtan Ferry is a nationally protected cultural relic.

fields.description: 朱德电文写作“林滩”。1935 年 2 月 20 日军委纵队在淋滩搭浮桥渡过赤水河；3 月 21 日红一军团等部再次由此东渡。具体渡河点含塘房等，本坐标标注为近似位置。 Zhu De’s telegrams spell the name “Lin Tan.” On 20 February 1935, the Military Commission’s column crossed the Chishui River over a pontoon bridge at Lintan; on 21 March, the First Army Corps and other units crossed eastward here again. The exact crossing points include Tangfang and others; this coordinate is approximate.

summary.en: After the second crossing of the Chishui River, the Central Red Army took Tongzi, Loushan Pass, and Zunyi within five days, routing two divisions and eight regiments of KMT forces.

fields.name: 遵义战役 Battle of Zunyi 遵义大捷 Zunyi Victory 二占遵义 Second Capture of Zunyi
fields.place: 贵州遵义老城（战役范围含桐梓、娄山关、遵义、忠庄铺） Zunyi old city, Guizhou (the campaign spanned Tongzi, Loushan Pass, Zunyi, and Zhongzhuangpu)
fields.summary: 中央红军二渡赤水后五日之内连下桐梓、娄山关、遵义，击溃和歼灭国民党军两个师又八个团。 After the second crossing of the Chishui River, the Central Red Army took Tongzi, Loushan Pass, and Zunyi within five days, routing two divisions and eight regiments of KMT forces.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 24 日至 3 月 1 日，中央红军二渡赤水后回师黔北，先取桐梓，再夺娄山关，27 日夜至 28 日晨重占遵义，随后在城南红花岗、老鸦山一带击退吴奇伟纵队反扑，并乘胜追至乌江边。此役击溃和歼灭国民党军两个师又八个团，毙伤约 2400 人，俘约 3000 人，是长征以来最大的一次胜利。多数战史记为 2 月 24 日至 28 日；本条目延至 3 月 1 日，以涵盖乌江边追击阶段。桐梓、娄山关、遵义城、红花岗、老鸦山、忠庄铺等地分列独立事件。 From 24 February to 1 March 1935, after crossing the Chishui River a second time, the Central Red Army returned to northern Guizhou. It took Tongzi, seized Loushan Pass, retook Zunyi on the night of 27–28 February, then repulsed Wu Qiwei’s counterattack at Honghuagang and Laoyashan south of the city and pursued the enemy to the Wu River. The campaign routed two divisions and eight regiments, with about 2,400 enemy killed or wounded and 3,000 captured, the largest victory since the Long March began. Most accounts date it 24–28 February; this entry extends to 1 March to include the pursuit to the Wu River. Tongzi, Loushan Pass, Zunyi, Honghuagang, Laoyashan, and Zhongzhuangpu are separate events.

summary.en: The leading regiment of the First Army Corps seized Tongzi, opening the Zunyi campaign.

fields.name: 攻占桐梓 Capture of Tongzi 奇袭桐梓 Surprise Capture of Tongzi
fields.place: 贵州桐梓县城 Tongzi county town, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红一军团先头团进占桐梓，揭开遵义战役序幕。 The leading regiment of the First Army Corps seized Tongzi, opening the Zunyi campaign.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 24 日，红一军团先头团进占桐梓县城，守敌退守娄山关。桐梓是遵义以北的门户，红军攻占桐梓后随即向娄山关发起进攻。本坐标为桐梓县城代表点，具体攻城街巷与阵地待考。 On 24 February 1935, the leading regiment of the First Army Corps entered Tongzi county town. The defenders withdrew to Loushan Pass. Tongzi was the gateway north of Zunyi; after taking it, the Red Army immediately attacked Loushan Pass. The coordinate is a representative point for the county town; the exact streets and positions of the assault await verification.

summary.zh: 红军在娄山关击溃黔军，取得长征以来首次大捷，为再占遵义打开通道。
summary.en: The Red Army routed Guizhou troops at Loushan Pass, its first major victory of the Long March, opening the way to retake Zunyi.

fields.name: 娄山关战斗 Battle of Loushan Pass 娄山关大捷 Loushan Pass Victory
fields.place: 贵州桐梓、遵义交界（娄山关） Loushan Pass on the Tongzi–Zunyi border, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红军在娄山关击溃黔军，取得长征以来首次大捷，为再占遵义打开通道。 The Red Army routed Guizhou troops at Loushan Pass, its first major victory of the Long March, opening the way to retake Zunyi.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 25 日至 26 日，红一、红三军团在彭德怀、杨尚昆统一指挥下进攻娄山关，歼灭和击溃黔军四个团，26 日占领关口，并乘胜向遵义追击。娄山关位于桐梓、遵义交界的川黔古道上，是遵义以北的天然屏障。此役是遵义战役的前奏；部分资料将攻占娄山关记在 25 日晚，本条目按 25 日至 26 日处理。 From 25 to 26 February 1935, the First and Third Army Corps, under Peng Dehuai and Yang Shangkun, attacked Loushan Pass, routing four Guizhou regiments. The pass fell on 26 February and the Red Army pursued toward Zunyi. Loushan Pass lies on the old Sichuan–Guizhou road on the Tongzi–Zunyi border and was the natural barrier north of Zunyi. The battle was the prelude to the Zunyi campaign. Some accounts date the capture to the evening of 25 February; this entry treats it as 25–26 February.

place.en: East bank of the Xiang River outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city, Guizhou (near Gong’an Pass)

summary.zh: 红三军团参谋长邓萍在遵义老城北门外侦察时中弹牺牲，年仅 27 岁。
summary.en: Deng Ping, chief of staff of the Third Army Corps, was killed by a bullet while reconnoitering outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city. He was 27.

fields.name: 邓萍牺牲 Death of Deng Ping 邓萍烈士牺牲地 Site of Deng Ping’s Death
fields.place: 贵州遵义老城北门外湘江东岸（拱安关附近） East bank of the Xiang River outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city, Guizhou (near Gong’an Pass)
fields.summary: 红三军团参谋长邓萍在遵义老城北门外侦察时中弹牺牲，年仅 27 岁。 Deng Ping, chief of staff of the Third Army Corps, was killed by a bullet while reconnoitering outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city. He was 27.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 27 日黄昏，红三军团参谋长邓萍率红十一团政委张爱萍、团参谋长兰国清，在遵义老城北门外拱安关斜对面、湘江东岸土埂侦察敌情时，被城内守军冷枪击中头部牺牲，年仅 27 岁，是中央红军长征中牺牲的职务最高的将领。彭德怀随后下令“拿下遵义城，为参谋长报仇”，28 日晨红军攻占遵义老城。牺牲日期另有 2 月 26 日说，本条目从 27 日说。 At dusk on 27 February 1935, Deng Ping, chief of staff of the Third Army Corps, went with Zhang Aiping, political commissar of the 11th Regiment, and the regiment’s chief of staff Lan Guoqing to reconnoiter outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city, on the east bank of the Xiang River opposite Gong’an Pass. A shot from the defenders struck him in the head and killed him. He was 27 and was the most senior Red Army commander to die during the Long March. Peng Dehuai ordered that Zunyi be taken in revenge, and the old city fell at dawn on 28 February. Some accounts give 26 February as the date of death; this entry follows 27 February.

summary.zh: 红十一团坚守红花岗，打退吴奇伟部多次进攻。
summary.en: The 11th Regiment held Honghuagang and repulsed repeated attacks by Wu Qiwei’s forces.

fields.name: 红花岗战斗 Battle of Honghuagang 红花岗阻击战 Honghuagang Blocking Battle
fields.place: 贵州遵义城南红花岗（兰家堡垭口一带） Honghuagang south of Zunyi, Guizhou (Lanjiabao pass area)
fields.summary: 红十一团坚守红花岗，打退吴奇伟部多次进攻。 The 11th Regiment held Honghuagang and repulsed repeated attacks by Wu Qiwei’s forces.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 28 日上午，吴奇伟纵队以第五十九师、第九十三师及黔军残部反攻遵义，首先猛攻红花岗南坡和兰家堡垭口。红十一团在团长邓国清、政委张爱萍指挥下居高临下，打退敌军多次冲锋，守住阵地。敌军转攻老鸦山后，红花岗仍是红军城南防线的重要支点。本坐标为红花岗山脊代表点，海拔约 1002 米，具体战壕与阵地待实测。 On the morning of 28 February 1935, Wu Qiwei’s column, with the 59th and 93rd Divisions and remnants of Wang Jialie’s Guizhou troops, counterattacked Zunyi and first struck the southern slope of Honghuagang and the Lanjiabao pass. The 11th Regiment, under regimental commander Deng Guoqing and political commissar Zhang Aiping, held the high ground and repulsed repeated charges. After the enemy shifted its main effort to Laoyashan, Honghuagang remained a key anchor of the Red Army’s southern defense line. The coordinate is a representative point on the Honghuagang ridge at about 1,002 m; the trenches and positions await field verification.

summary.en: The 10th Regiment fought back and forth for the Laoyashan summit; the Cadre Regiment counterattacked and retook it.

fields.name: 老鸦山战斗 Battle of Laoyashan 老鸦山争夺战 Struggle for Laoyashan
fields.place: 贵州遵义城西南老鸦山（土地坝垭口一带） Laoyashan southwest of Zunyi, Guizhou (Tudiba pass area)
fields.summary: 红十团与敌反复争夺老鸦山主峰，干部团增援后夺回阵地。 The 10th Regiment fought back and forth for the Laoyashan summit; the Cadre Regiment counterattacked and retook it.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 28 日，吴奇伟部第五十九师在飞机大炮掩护下转攻老鸦山和土地坝垭口。红十团团长张宗逊、政委黄克诚率部顽强抗击，主峰一度失守，张宗逊重伤，团参谋长钟伟剑牺牲。红十三团一部投入反击；黄昏时分，陈赓、宋任穷率军委干部团从侧翼助攻，红军夺回老鸦山主峰，并全线击溃敌军。本坐标为老鸦山主峰附近代表点，海拔约 1053 米，具体战壕与文保碑位置待实测。 On 28 February 1935, the 59th Division of Wu Qiwei’s column, supported by aircraft and artillery, shifted its attack to Laoyashan and the Tudiba pass. The 10th Regiment under Zhang Zongsun and political commissar Huang Kecheng resisted stubbornly; the summit was lost for a time, Zhang was seriously wounded, and the regiment’s chief of staff Zhong Weijian was killed. Part of the 13th Regiment joined the counterattack, and at dusk Chen Geng and Song Renqiong led the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment in a flank attack that retook the summit and routed the enemy along the whole line. The coordinate is a representative point near the summit at about 1,053 m; the trenches and the heritage marker await field verification.

summary.en: The main force of the First Army Corps drove at Wu Qiwei’s column headquarters, precipitating a general collapse.

fields.name: 奔袭忠庄铺 Raid on Zhongzhuangpu 忠庄铺战斗 Battle of Zhongzhuangpu
fields.place: 贵州遵义城南忠庄铺 Zhongzhuangpu south of Zunyi, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红一军团主力直插吴奇伟纵队指挥部，敌军全线溃退。 The main force of the First Army Corps drove at Wu Qiwei’s column headquarters, precipitating a general collapse.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 28 日，当红军在红花岗、老鸦山与敌激战时，红一军团主力从水师坝地区向敌侧后出击，直插忠庄铺吴奇伟纵队指挥部。吴奇伟仓皇南逃，率残部过乌江后砍断浮桥，滞留在北岸的约 1800 名敌军被红军俘获。忠庄铺战斗打乱了敌军指挥，是遵义战役转入追击的关键一击。本坐标为忠庄街道代表点，指挥部具体位置待考。 On 28 February 1935, while the Red Army was fighting at Honghuagang and Laoyashan, the main force of the First Army Corps struck from the Shuishiba area toward the enemy’s flank and rear, driving straight at Wu Qiwei’s column headquarters at Zhongzhuangpu. Wu fled south in haste; after crossing the Wu River with his remaining troops he cut the pontoon bridge, leaving about 1,800 men on the north bank to be captured. The action disrupted the enemy command and marked the turn from defense to pursuit in the Zunyi campaign. The coordinate is a representative point in Zhongzhuang; the exact headquarters site awaits verification.

summary.zh: 中央在苟坝召开会议，撤销进攻打鼓新场计划，成立新三人团。
summary.en: The central leadership met at Gouba, cancelled the attack on Daguxinchang, and formed the new three-man military group.

fields.name: 苟坝会议 Gouba Meeting 苟坝政治局扩大会议 Gouba Enlarged Politburo Meeting 打鼓新场会议 Daguxinchang Meeting
fields.place: 贵州遵义枫香镇苟坝村 Gouba Village, Fengxiang, Zunyi, Guizhou
fields.summary: 中央在苟坝召开会议，撤销进攻打鼓新场计划，成立新三人团。 The central leadership met at Gouba, cancelled the attack on Daguxinchang, and formed the new three-man military group.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 10 日至 12 日，中央政治局在遵义苟坝召开扩大会议，讨论是否进攻打鼓新场。毛泽东力主不打，会议一度表决撤销其前敌司令部政委职务；毛泽东当夜提马灯找周恩来、朱德，说服暂缓发令。11 日会议决定撤销进攻计划；12 日决定成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥组成的新三人团，全权指挥军事。本坐标为苟坝村代表点，会议会址与周恩来、朱德旧居待分别落位。 From 10 to 12 March 1935, the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Gouba in Zunyi to discuss whether to attack Daguxinchang. Mao Zedong opposed the attack; the meeting at one point voted to remove him as political commissar of the front command. That night Mao walked with a lantern to Zhou Enlai and Zhu De and persuaded them to delay the order. On 11 March the meeting cancelled the attack; on 12 March it decided to form a new three-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, and Wang Jiaxiang with full authority over military operations. The coordinate is a representative point at Gouba; the meeting site and the former residences of Zhou Enlai and Zhu De await separate placement.

place.en: Lubanchang, Renhuai, Guizhou (Baijia’ao area, Huangjiatian Village, Luban Subdistrict)

summary.zh: 红军强攻周浑元纵队鲁班场阵地未克，随后转兵茅台三渡赤水。
summary.en: The Red Army’s assault on Zhou Hunyuan’s positions at Lubanchang failed to break through, and it turned toward Maotai for the third crossing of the Chishui.

fields.name: 鲁班场战斗 Battle of Lubanchang 鲁班场攻坚战 Assault on Lubanchang
fields.place: 贵州仁怀鲁班场（今鲁班街道黄家田村白家坳一带） Lubanchang, Renhuai, Guizhou (Baijia’ao area, Huangjiatian Village, Luban Subdistrict)
fields.summary: 红军强攻周浑元纵队鲁班场阵地未克，随后转兵茅台三渡赤水。 The Red Army’s assault on Zhou Hunyuan’s positions at Lubanchang failed to break through, and it turned toward Maotai for the third crossing of the Chishui.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 15 日，红一、红三、红五军团及军委干部团向据守仁怀鲁班场的国民党军周浑元纵队三个师发起进攻。敌军依托白家坳、团标寺、凉水井、老坑嘴、白果寺、丁家山、羊角岭一带的碉堡工事顽抗，并有飞机助战，红军多路进攻未能突破。战至当晚，红军主动撤出战斗，向茅台方向转移，16 日至 17 日由茅台三渡赤水。此役红军伤亡 489 人，歼敌 400 余人；虽未攻克鲁班场，但为三渡赤水争取了主动。本坐标为鲁班场/白家坳代表点，战场范围较大，具体阵地待实测。 On 15 March 1935, the First, Third, and Fifth Army Corps and the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment attacked three divisions of Zhou Hunyuan’s column at Lubanchang in Renhuai. The defenders held firm in fortified positions around Baijia’ao, Tuanbiaosi, Liangshuijing, Laokengzui, Baiguosi, Dingjiashan, and Yangjiaoling, supported by aircraft, and the Red Army’s multiple attacks failed to break through. That evening the Red Army withdrew toward Maotai and crossed the Chishui River for the third time on 16–17 March. The Red Army suffered 489 casualties and killed or wounded more than 400 enemy soldiers. Although Lubanchang was not taken, the battle gained the initiative for the third crossing. The coordinate is a representative point for Lubanchang/Baijia’ao; the battlefield is extensive and the exact positions await field verification.

summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai’s middle, lower, and Yintan ferries, feinting to draw off enemy forces.

fields.name: 三渡赤水 Third crossing of the Chishui River 三渡赤水河 Third Crossing of the Chishui
fields.place: 贵州仁怀茅台渡口（中渡口、下渡口、银滩） Maotai ferries, Renhuai, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红军在茅台中渡口、下渡口、银滩西渡赤水河，佯动调动敌军。 The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai’s middle, lower, and Yintan ferries, feinting to draw off enemy forces.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 16 日至 17 日，中央红军在贵州仁怀茅台镇中渡口、下渡口及银滩搭设三座浮桥，西渡赤水河，再次进入川南，作出北渡长江姿态，诱使国民党军西调。下渡口西岸朱砂堡现立茅台渡口纪念碑。 From 16 to 17 March 1935, the Central Red Army built three pontoon bridges at Maotai’s middle ferry, lower ferry, and Yintan, crossed the Chishui River westward, re-entered southern Sichuan, and feinted a Yangtze crossing to draw Kuomintang forces west. The Maotai Ferry Monument now stands at Zhushabao on the west bank of the lower ferry.

fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 21 日至 22 日，中央红军主力分路从二郎滩、太平渡、九溪口、淋滩等渡口秘密东渡赤水河，把敌军甩在赤水河西岸，随后南渡乌江、佯攻贵阳、西进云南。各军团具体渡口在不同史料中记载略有差异，本条目只列主要渡口，不把军团分配写成唯一结论。 From 21 to 22 March 1935, the main force of the Central Red Army secretly crossed the Chishui River eastward in several columns at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, and Lintan, leaving enemy forces on the west bank; it then crossed the Wu River southward, feinted toward Guiyang, and moved west into Yunnan. Sources differ slightly on which corps used which ferry, so this entry lists the main ferries without asserting a single corps-to-ferry assignment.

fields.name: 强渡嘉陵江 Forcing the Jialing River 嘉陵江战役 Jialing River Campaign 红四方面军开始长征 The Fourth Front Army Begins the Long March

fields.summary: 红四方面军强渡嘉陵江，策应中央红军，开始长征。 The Fourth Front Army forced the Jialing River to support the Central Red Army and began its Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 28 日至 4 月 21 日，红四方面军为策应中央红军、向川甘边界发展，在苍溪、阆中间强渡嘉陵江。红 30 军从塔子山主渡，红 31 军从鸳溪口、红 9 军从涧溪口渡江，红 4 军为第二梯队。渡江后攻占剑门关、昭化、南部、剑阁、梓潼、江油、中坝、青川、平武、北川等地，歼敌 1 万余人，控制嘉陵江与涪江之间广大地区。从强渡嘉陵江起，红四方面军实际上开始长征。本坐标为苍溪塔子山渡口代表点。 From 28 March to 21 April 1935, the Fourth Front Army forced the Jialing River between Cangxi and Langzhong to support the Central Red Army and expand toward the Sichuan–Gansu border. The 30th Army crossed at the Tazishan main crossing, the 31st Army at Yuanxikou, and the 9th Army at Jianxikou, with the 4th Army as the second echelon. After crossing, the Red Army took Jianmen Pass, Zhaohua, Nanbu, Jiange, Zitong, Jiangyou, Zhongba, Qingchuan, Pingwu, and Beichuan, destroyed more than 10,000 enemy troops, and controlled the area between the Jialing and Fu rivers. From this crossing, the Fourth Front Army effectively began its Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Tazishan ferry in Cangxi.

fields.summary: 中央红军从江口、大塘、梯子岩南渡乌江，跳出乌江以北包围圈。 The Central Red Army crossed the Wu River southward at Jiangkou, Datang, and Tiziyan, escaping the encirclement north of the river.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 29 日，红一军团先遣部队进至金沙后山乌江边，红三团袭击江口、大塘、梯子岩渡口，工兵连夜架设浮桥。30 日至 31 日，红一、红三军团及军委纵队先后渡江；4 月 1 日红五军团渡江完毕，中央红军主力全部进入息烽境内。南渡乌江为四渡赤水画上句号，把国民党军主力甩在乌江以北。本坐标为后山渡口群代表点，三个渡口待分别落位。 On 29 March 1935, the advance guard of the First Army Corps reached the Wu River at Houshan, Jinsha. The Third Regiment attacked the Jiangkou, Datang, and Tiziyan ferries, and engineers built pontoon bridges overnight. On 30–31 March the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column crossed; the Fifth Army Corps finished on 1 April, and the main force entered Xifeng county. The crossing closed the Four Crossings of the Chishui campaign and left the main KMT forces north of the Wu River. The coordinate is a representative point for the Houshan ferry group; the three ferries await separate placement.
