fields.place: 贵州贵阳附近 Near Guiyang, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红军逼近贵阳、佯攻龙里，调出滇军，为西进云南打开通道。 The Red Army threatened Guiyang and feinted at Longli, drawing out the Yunnan army and opening the route west into Yunnan.
fields.description: 1935 年 4 月 2 日，中央红军以一部佯攻息烽，主力进至扎佐、狗场，前锋逼近贵阳。蒋介石急调滇军孙渡纵队星夜赴贵阳“保驾”，并将各路敌军向贵阳以东集中。4 月 5 日，红军又在清水江架桥作东渡姿态，进一步迷惑敌军。4 月 8 日至 9 日，红军从贵阳、龙里间狭窄地段穿过湘黔公路，向西进入云南。本坐标为贵阳附近代表点，具体佯攻阵地待考。 On 2 April 1935, part of the Central Red Army feinted at Xifeng while the main force reached Zhazuo and Gaochang, with its advance guard approaching Guiyang. Chiang Kai-shek urgently summoned Sun Du’s Yunnan column to defend Guiyang and concentrated other forces east of the city. On 5 April the Red Army built bridges over the Qingshui River to suggest an eastward crossing, further misleading the enemy. On 8–9 April it passed through the narrow gap between Guiyang and Longli, crossed the Hunan–Guizhou highway, and moved west into Yunnan. The coordinate is a representative point near Guiyang; the exact feint positions await verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 4 月至 5 月，蒋介石命云南省政府主席龙云收缴沿江船只、封锁渡口，滇军孙渡纵队等部尾追；川康边防军刘元瑭部等防守金沙江北岸与通安、会理。红军以龙街渡、洪门渡佯动牵制敌军，主力从皎平渡渡江，并在石板河击退追兵，突破金沙江封锁。本坐标为皎平渡代表点，防线沿金沙江展开。 From April to May 1935, Chiang Kai-shek ordered Yunnan governor Long Yun to collect boats and blockade the river; Sun Du’s Yunnan troops pursued, while Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan border troops defended the north bank, Tongan, and Huili. The Red Army feinted at Longjie and Hongmen, crossed the main force at Jiaopingdu, and halted the pursuers at Shibanhe, breaking the Jinsha River blockade. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu; the line extended along the Jinsha River.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月至 1936 年 10 月，川军刘湘、刘文辉、邓锡侯等部在川陕甘边对红四方面军进行堵截与追击，红军在川西北与甘孜地区与国民党军周旋，最终北上会宁。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From May 1935 to October 1936, Sichuan troops under Liu Xiang, Liu Wenhui and Deng Xihou blocked and pursued the Red Fourth Front Army along the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu border; the Red Army maneuvered in northwestern Sichuan and the Garzê region before marching north to Huining. fields.place: 云南禄劝皎平渡 Jiaopingdu, Luquan, Yunnan
fields.summary: 中央红军主力从皎平渡巧渡金沙江，跳出数十万敌军围堵。 The main force of the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu, escaping the encirclement of hundreds of thousands of KMT troops.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 9 日，中央红军主力在皎平渡，以 6 条木船、37 名船工，历时 7 天 7 夜渡过金沙江。此前红一、红三军团分别在龙街渡、洪门渡受阻，先后转至皎平渡；红五军团在石板河阻击追敌，红九军团从树桔渡过江。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军 3 万余人全部过江，粉碎了蒋介石围歼红军于川黔滇边境的计划。本坐标为皎平渡渡口代表点。 From 3 to 9 May 1935, the main force of the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu with six boats and 37 boatmen over seven days and nights. The First and Third Army Corps had been blocked at Longjie and Hongmen and shifted to Jiaopingdu; the Fifth Army Corps blocked the pursuers at Shibanhe, and the Ninth Army Corps crossed at Shuju. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops had crossed, foiling Chiang Kai-shek’s plan to destroy the Red Army on the Sichuan–Guizhou–Yunnan border. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu.

fields.place: 云南禄劝皎平渡（战役范围含龙街、洪门、树桔渡） Jiaopingdu, Luquan, Yunnan (the campaign spanned Longjie, Hongmen, and Shuju ferries)
fields.summary: 中央红军分三路抢渡金沙江，主力从皎平渡过江，跳出数十万敌军围堵。 The Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River in three columns, with the main force crossing at Jiaopingdu and escaping the encirclement of hundreds of thousands of KMT troops.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 9 日，中央红军分三路抢渡金沙江：红一军团攻龙街渡，红三军团攻洪门渡，军委纵队和红五军团抢占皎平渡；红九军团从树桔渡渡江。龙街、洪门两渡因江宽流急、船只缺乏未能架桥，红一、红三军团主力先后转至皎平渡。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军主力 3 万余人从皎平渡全部过江，粉碎了蒋介石围歼红军于川黔滇边境的计划。皎平渡、龙街渡、洪门渡、树桔渡、石板河阻击战、通安战斗分列独立事件。 From 3 to 9 May 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River in three columns: the First Army Corps moved on Longjie Ferry, the Third Army Corps on Hongmen Ferry, and the Central Military Commission column with the Fifth Army Corps seized Jiaopingdu; the Ninth Army Corps crossed at Shuju Ferry. Longjie and Hongmen could not be bridged because of the wide, swift river and lack of boats, and the main forces of the First and Third Corps shifted to Jiaopingdu. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops had crossed at Jiaopingdu, foiling Chiang Kai-shek’s plan to destroy the Red Army on the Sichuan–Guizhou–Yunnan border. Jiaopingdu, Longjie, Hongmen, Shuju, the Shibanhe blocking battle, and the Tongan battle are separate events.

fields.summary: 皎平渡是中央红军主力渡金沙江的主渡口，6 条木船、37 名船工昼夜摆渡 7 天 7 夜。 Jiaopingdu was the main crossing of the Jinsha River for the Central Red Army, where six boats and 37 boatmen ferried troops for seven days and nights.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日黄昏，刘伯承率军委干部团先遣队抢占皎平渡南岸，夺得木船 2 只，夜渡控制北岸中武山渡口。随后红军又找到 4 只船，共 6 只，并动员 37 名船工，在刘伯承、陈云分任司令员、政委的渡江指挥部统一调度下，按《渡江守则》编队编号、昼夜摆渡。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军主力 3 万余人全部由此过江。本坐标为皎平渡渡口代表点，南岸起渡点与北岸红军洞待实测。 At dusk on 3 May 1935, Liu Bocheng led the advance detachment of the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment to seize the south bank at Jiaopingdu, captured two boats, and crossed at night to control the Zhongwushan landing on the north bank. The Red Army found four more boats, six in total, and mobilized 37 boatmen. Under the crossing command headed by Liu Bocheng and Chen Yun, and the “Crossing Rules”, the boats were numbered and ferried day and night. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops of the main force had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu; the south-bank launching point and the north-bank Red Army cave await verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红一军团先头部队到达元谋龙街渡，渡船已被敌军毁坏；红军在花石滩架设浮桥，因江宽流急、敌机轰炸未成。红军以少量部队继续架桥佯渡，吸引国民党军主力向元谋方向集中，掩护主力从皎平渡渡江。5 月 5 日，红一军团奉命顺江而下，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为龙街渡代表点。 On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the First Army Corps reached Longjie Ferry in Yuanmou, but the enemy had destroyed the boats. An attempt to build a pontoon bridge at Huashitan failed because of the wide, swift river and enemy air attacks. A small force continued the bridge feint, drawing KMT forces toward Yuanmou and covering the main crossing at Jiaopingdu. On 5 May the First Army Corps was ordered downstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at Longjie Ferry.

summary.en: The Fifth Army Corps blocked KMT forces at Shibanhe for seven days and nights, covering the main force’s crossing.

fields.name: 石板河阻击战 Shibanhe Blocking Battle 石板河战斗 Battle of Shibanhe
fields.place: 云南禄劝石板河小庙垭口一带 Xiaomiao pass area, Shibanhe, Luquan, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红五军团在石板河阻击国民党军 7 昼夜，掩护主力渡江。 The Fifth Army Corps blocked KMT forces at Shibanhe for seven days and nights, covering the main force’s crossing.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红五军团奉命在禄劝石板河一线构筑阵地，阻击尾追的国民党军万耀煌第 13 师等部，掩护中央纵队从皎平渡渡江。红军依托小庙垭口等险要地形，坚守 7 昼夜，打退敌军多次进攻；5 月 9 日完成掩护任务后，撤出阵地，急行军至皎平渡过江。本坐标为石板河/小庙垭口代表点，具体战壕与阵地待实测。 On 3 May 1935, the Fifth Army Corps was ordered to build positions at Shibanhe in Luquan to block the pursuing KMT 13th Division under Wan Yaohuang and cover the central column’s crossing at Jiaopingdu. Holding strong points such as the Xiaomiao pass, the corps resisted for seven days and nights and repulsed repeated attacks. On 9 May, after completing the mission, it withdrew and marched rapidly to Jiaopingdu to cross. The coordinate is a representative point at Shibanhe/Xiaomiao pass; the trenches and positions await verification.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

summary.en: The CMC Cadre Regiment seized Tongan, opening the advance route north of Jiaopingdu.

fields.name: 通安战斗 Battle of Tongan 夺取通安 Capture of Tongan
fields.place: 四川会理通安镇 Tongan, Huili, Sichuan
fields.summary: 军委干部团夺取通安，打开皎平渡北岸的前进通道。 The CMC Cadre Regiment seized Tongan, opening the advance route north of Jiaopingdu.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日，军委干部团在陈赓、宋任穷率领下渡过金沙江，向通安推进，击溃川军刘元瑭部，占领通安镇，保障了皎平渡渡口北岸的安全。通安是皎平渡通往会理的要道。本坐标为通安镇代表点，具体战斗阵地待考。 On 3–4 May 1935, the CMC Cadre Regiment under Chen Geng and Song Renqiong crossed the Jinsha River and advanced on Tongan, routing Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops and seizing the town, securing the north bank at Jiaopingdu. Tongan was the key route from Jiaopingdu to Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for Tongan; the exact positions await verification.

summary.zh: 红三军团在洪门渡架桥未成，仅红十三团由一只木船渡过，主力转赴皎平渡。
summary.en: The Third Army Corps failed to bridge the Hongmen Ferry; only the 13th Regiment crossed by a single boat, and the main force shifted to Jiaopingdu.

fields.name: 洪门渡 Hongmen Ferry 河门渡 Hemen Ferry 可河渡口 Kehe Ferry
fields.place: 云南禄劝洪门渡（北岸为四川会东可河） Hongmen Ferry, Luquan, Yunnan (Kehe, Huidong, Sichuan on the north bank)
fields.summary: 红三军团在洪门渡架桥未成，仅红十三团由一只木船渡过，主力转赴皎平渡。 The Third Army Corps failed to bridge the Hongmen Ferry; only the 13th Regiment crossed by a single boat, and the main force shifted to Jiaopingdu.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红三军团先头部队到达禄劝洪门渡，江面不宽但水流湍急，架设浮桥被冲毁。红军找到一只小木船，在船工帮助下昼夜摆渡，仅红十三团渡过金沙江，占领北岸可河街。5 月 5 日，红三军团主力奉命逆江而上，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为洪门渡/可河渡口代表点。 On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the Third Army Corps reached Hongmen Ferry in Luquan. The river was narrow but swift, and the pontoon bridge was swept away. The Red Army found a small boat and, with local boatmen, ferried the 13th Regiment across to seize Kehe Street on the north bank. On 5 May the main force was ordered upstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hongmen/Kehe ferry.
fields.entities: 中央红军（红一方面军） Central Red Army

summary.en: The Ninth Army Corps crossed the Jinsha River at Shuju Ferry, completing its flanking and diversion task.

fields.name: 树桔渡 Shuju Ferry 树桔渡口 Shuju Crossing 东川树桔渡 Shuju Ferry, Dongchuan
fields.place: 云南东川拖布卡镇树桔村金沙江渡口 Shuju Village, Tuobuka, Dongchuan, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红九军团从树桔渡渡过金沙江，完成侧翼牵制任务。 The Ninth Army Corps crossed the Jinsha River at Shuju Ferry, completing its flanking and diversion task.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，红九军团先头部队到达东川树桔渡，在船工帮助下打捞修补一只沉船，连夜摆渡 13 次，将 200 余人送过江。随后红军夺取北岸汪家坪盐场，打捞被封沉的盐船，5 月 5 日至 6 日全军团 3400 余人由树桔渡渡过金沙江。本坐标为树桔渡代表点，渡江指挥所旧址在白鹤滩蓄水前位于树桔村田尾巴。 On 4 May 1935, the advance guard of the Ninth Army Corps reached Shuju Ferry in Dongchuan. With local boatmen they raised and repaired a sunken boat and ferried more than 200 men across in 13 trips overnight. The Red Army then seized the Wangjiaping salt works on the north bank and recovered the sunken salt boats; on 5–6 May the entire corps of more than 3,400 crossed at Shuju. The coordinate is a representative point at Shuju Ferry; the crossing command site stood at Tianweiba, Shuju Village, before the Baihetan reservoir.

summary.zh: 红军在皎平渡北岸岩洞设立渡江指挥部，统一调度全军渡江。
summary.en: The Red Army set up a crossing command in a cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu to coordinate the crossing.

fields.name: 皎平渡渡江指挥部 Jiaopingdu Crossing Command 渡江司令部 River Crossing Command 北岸红军洞 Red Army Cave on the North Bank
fields.place: 云南禄劝皎平渡北岸岩洞（今属四川会理中武山） Cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu (now Zhongwushan, Huili, Sichuan)
fields.summary: 红军在皎平渡北岸岩洞设立渡江指挥部，统一调度全军渡江。 The Red Army set up a crossing command in a cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu to coordinate the crossing.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，毛泽东、朱德、周恩来等率军委纵队从皎平渡过江后，在江北岸一孔天然岩洞设立渡江指挥部，由刘伯承任司令员、陈云任政委，颁布《渡江守则》，统一调度船只、船工与各部队渡江顺序。指挥部同时处理电报、筹粮与船工保障，是皎平渡 7 天 7 夜有序渡江的中枢。本坐标为北岸红军洞代表点，原洞已在乌东德水库蓄水后淹没，现为原址附近纪念点。 After Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, and the CMC column crossed at Jiaopingdu on 4 May 1935, they established a crossing command in a natural cave on the north bank. Liu Bocheng served as commander and Chen Yun as political commissar; the command issued the “Crossing Rules” and coordinated boats, boatmen, and the crossing order of each unit. It also handled telegrams, grain, and boatmen’s support, forming the hub of the seven-day crossing. The coordinate is a representative point at the north-bank Red Army cave; the original cave was submerged by the Wudongde reservoir, and a memorial now stands nearby.

summary.en: The Third Army Corps besieged Huili for seven days and nights before withdrawing and moving north.

fields.name: 会理攻城 Siege of Huili 围攻会理 Encircling Huili 会理攻坚战 Assault on Huili
fields.place: 四川会理古城 Huili old city, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红三军团围攻会理城 7 天 7 夜，未克后撤围北上。 The Third Army Corps besieged Huili for seven days and nights before withdrawing and moving north.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 8 日，红三军团到达会理城郊，夺取城东东山寺、城西南西来寺等制高点，包围会理城；9 日，军委干部团加入攻城。红军主攻北、西两面，连续攻城并挖掘坑道，14 日以棺材装火药炸开西北角城墙，守军刘元瑭部堵住缺口，红军攻城未克。7 天 7 夜后，中革军委决定停止攻城，撤围北上。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体攻城阵地待考。 On 8 May 1935, the Third Army Corps reached the outskirts of Huili, seized the Dongshan and Xilai temples and other high ground, and encircled the city; on 9 May the CMC Cadre Regiment joined the assault. The Red Army attacked the north and west sides, dug tunnels, and on 14 May blew a breach in the northwest wall with gunpowder packed in a coffin, but Liu Yuantang’s defenders sealed it. After seven days and nights, the CMC ordered the siege lifted and the army moved north. The coordinate is a representative point for Huili old city; the exact assault positions await verification.

summary.zh: 川军刘元瑭部死守会理，烧毁城外民房、封闭城门，红军攻城未克。
summary.en: Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops held Huili, burning houses outside the walls and sealing the gates; the Red Army failed to take the city.

fields.name: 川军会理防线 Sichuan Army’s Huili Defense 刘元瑭部会理守城 Liu Yuantang’s Defense of Huili 会理城防 Huili City Defenses
fields.place: 四川会理古城 Huili old city, Sichuan
fields.summary: 川军刘元瑭部死守会理，烧毁城外民房、封闭城门，红军攻城未克。 Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops held Huili, burning houses outside the walls and sealing the gates; the Red Army failed to take the city.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月，川军刘元瑭部（第 7 师等）防守会理城。守军为清除射界，用煤油、棉花烧毁城外北关、西关、东关民房，封闭四门，撬起街石堵塞城门，并强迫军警死守。红三军团与军委干部团围攻 7 天 7 夜，爆破西北角城墙后，刘元瑭亲自率部堵击，面部受伤，仍堵住缺口。红军撤围后，守军仍固守会理。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体城防工事待考。 In May 1935, Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops (including the 7th Division) defended Huili. To clear fields of fire, they burned houses in the north, west, and east suburbs with kerosene and cotton, sealed the four gates, pried up street stones to block the gateways, and ordered the garrison to hold to the death. The Third Army Corps and the CMC Cadre Regiment besieged the city for seven days and nights; after the northwest wall was breached, Liu Yuantang personally led the counterattack, was wounded in the face, and sealed the gap. The Red Army withdrew, and the garrison held Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for the old city; the exact defenses await verification.

fields.name: 会理会议 Huili Meeting
fields.place: 四川会理城北铁厂村 Tiechang Village north of Huili, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，决定继续北上、抢渡大渡河。 The Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili and decided to continue north to force the Dadu River.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 12 日，中共中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，总结遵义会议以来的战略方针，批评部分同志对机动作战的怀疑，决定继续北上、越大渡河与红四方面军会合，并任命刘伯承为先遣队司令员、聂荣臻为政委。会议先在树林草棚中举行，因敌机侦察，后转移到平安寺继续。与会人员记载略有出入，本条目只列主要人员。本坐标为铁厂村会理会议纪念地代表点。 On 12 May 1935, the CCP Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili. It reviewed the strategy since the Zunyi Conference, criticized doubts about mobile warfare, decided to continue north across the Dadu River to join the Fourth Front Army, and appointed Liu Bocheng as advance detachment commander and Nie Rongzhen as political commissar. The meeting began in a makeshift shelter in the woods and moved to Ping’an Temple because of enemy air reconnaissance. Accounts of attendees differ slightly; this entry lists only the main participants. The coordinate is a representative point at the Tiechang meeting memorial site.

fields.summary: 刘伯承、聂荣臻在泸沽决定走冕宁—拖乌—安顺场小路，另派红五团佯动大树堡。 At Lugu, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen decided to take the Mianning–Tuowu–Anshunchang trail and sent the Fifth Regiment to feint at Dashubao.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 20 日晚，红军先遣队在冕宁泸沽决定改变原定经越西、大树堡的大路，改走冕宁、大桥、拖乌、彝海至安顺场的小路，以避开川军重兵；同时派左权、刘亚楼率红一军团第二师第五团等向越西、大树堡方向佯动，迷惑富林之敌。21 日，中革军委复电同意。本坐标为泸沽镇代表点。 On the night of 20 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment at Lugu in Mianning decided to abandon the main road via Yuexi and Dashubao for the trail through Mianning, Daqiao, Tuowu, and Yihai to Anshunchang, avoiding the main Sichuan forces. At the same time, Zuo Quan and Liu Yalou led the Fifth Regiment of the Second Division toward Yuexi and Dashubao as a feint to deceive the enemy at Fulin. On 21 May the CMC approved the change. The coordinate is a representative point for Lugu.

fields.summary: 红军先遣队进入冕宁，释放“换班坐质”彝族首领，随后成立冕宁县革命委员会。 The Red Army advance detachment entered Mianning, released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, and later established the Mianning Revolutionary Committee.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 21 日凌晨，刘伯承、聂荣臻率先遣队到达冕宁县城，在地下党配合下进城，释放被扣押的彝族“换班坐质”人质，焚毁强迫签署的文书，宣布废除换班坐质制度。5 月 23 日，红军在冕宁文庙召开群众大会，成立冕宁县革命委员会，陈野苹任主席、李井泉任副主席，并成立抗捐军。本坐标为冕宁县城代表点。 In the early hours of 21 May 1935, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen led the advance detachment into Mianning county town with local underground party support. They released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, burned the forced agreements, and abolished the system. On 23 May the Red Army held a mass meeting at the Mianning Confucian temple and established the Mianning County Revolutionary Committee, with Chen Yeping as chairman and Li Jingquan as vice chairman, along with an anti-tax militia. The coordinate is a representative point for the county town.

summary.en: Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan, leader of the Yi Guji clan, swore a blood oath at Yihai, allowing the Red Army to pass through Yi territory.

fields.name: 彝海结盟 Yihai Alliance 彝海歃血为盟 Blood Oath at Yihai 刘伯承与小叶丹结盟 Alliance between Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan
fields.place: 四川冕宁彝海镇彝海（袁居海子） Yihai (Yuanju Haizi), Yihai Town, Mianning, Sichuan
fields.summary: 刘伯承与彝族果基家支首领小叶丹在彝海歃血为盟，红军顺利通过彝区。 Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan, leader of the Yi Guji clan, swore a blood oath at Yihai, allowing the Red Army to pass through Yi territory.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 22 日，红军先遣队在冕宁以北彝海（袁居海子）与彝族果基家支首领果基约达（小叶丹）歃血为盟。因无酒，刘伯承以彝海水代酒，与小叶丹饮鸡血水结为兄弟；当晚授予小叶丹“中国夷民红军沽鸡支队”队旗，并赠送枪支。小叶丹随后派向导护送红军通过拖乌彝区，为强渡大渡河赢得时间。本坐标为彝海结盟取水点附近代表点。 On 22 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment swore a blood oath with Xiaoyedan (Guji Yueda), leader of the Yi Guji clan, at Yihai (Yuanju Haizi) north of Mianning. With no wine, Liu Bocheng used water from Yihai and drank chicken blood with Xiaoyedan as brothers. That evening he gave Xiaoyedan the banner of the “Chinese Yi Red Army Guji Detachment” and presented rifles. Xiaoyedan then sent guides to escort the Red Army through Tuowu Yi territory, gaining time for the Dadu River crossing. The coordinate is a representative point near the oath-taking site at Yihai.

summary.zh: 红一军团第二师第五团等佯攻大树堡，牵制富林川军，掩护安顺场主渡。
summary.en: The Fifth Regiment of the Second Division and other units feinted at Dashubao, pinning Sichuan troops at Fulin and covering the main crossing at Anshunchang.

fields.name: 大树堡佯攻 Dashubao Feint 佯攻大树堡 Feint on Dashubao 佯攻富林 Feint on Fulin
fields.place: 四川汉源大树堡（今大树镇） Dashubao (now Dashu Town), Hanyuan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红一军团第二师第五团等佯攻大树堡，牵制富林川军，掩护安顺场主渡。 The Fifth Regiment of the Second Division and other units feinted at Dashubao, pinning Sichuan troops at Fulin and covering the main crossing at Anshunchang.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 20 日夜，红一军团参谋长左权、第二师政委刘亚楼率第二师第五团等由泸沽分兵，经越西、海棠向大树堡挺进；23 日占领大树堡，24 日至 25 日在大渡河南岸大张旗鼓造船、扎筏、架线，制造由大树堡渡河攻打富林、雅安、成都的假象。北岸川军急调兵力增援富林，放松了安顺场至泸定一线的防守。26 日红五团奉命撤离大树堡，绕道返回安顺场。本坐标为大树堡镇代表点，渡口具体位置待实测。 On the night of 20 May 1935, Zuo Quan, chief of staff of the First Army Corps, and Liu Yalou, political commissar of the Second Division, led the Fifth Regiment and other units from Lugu via Yuexi and Haitang toward Dashubao. They took Dashubao on 23 May and on 24–25 May ostentatiously built boats and rafts and laid telephone lines on the south bank, creating the impression that the main force would cross at Dashubao and drive on Fulin, Ya’an, and Chengdu. Sichuan troops rushed reinforcements to Fulin, weakening the Anshunchang–Luding sector. On 26 May the Fifth Regiment withdrew and returned to Anshunchang. The coordinate is a representative point for Dashubao; the exact ferry site awaits verification.

place.en: Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan (the campaign spanned Dashubao, Moxi, and Luding Bridge)

summary.zh: 中央红军在安顺场强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥，粉碎川军围堵，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The Central Red Army forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the Sichuan army’s blockade and opening the route north.

fields.name: 大渡河战役 Dadu River Campaign 大渡河之役 Dadu River Operation 强渡大渡河与飞夺泸定桥 Forcing the Dadu and Seizing Luding Bridge
fields.place: 四川石棉安顺场（战役范围含大树堡、磨西、泸定桥） Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan (the campaign spanned Dashubao, Moxi, and Luding Bridge)
fields.summary: 中央红军在安顺场强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥，粉碎川军围堵，打开北上通道。 The Central Red Army forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the Sichuan army’s blockade and opening the route north.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 24 日至 29 日，中央红军先遣队夜袭安顺场，25 日十七勇士强渡大渡河；因船只不足，主力分左右两路沿大渡河两岸北上，29 日红四团夺取泸定桥，中央红军主力陆续过河。此役粉碎了蒋介石让红军成为“石达开第二”的企图，打开了北上川西的通道。战役范围含安顺场、大树堡佯动、磨西会议与泸定桥，分列独立事件。 From 24 to 29 May 1935, the Central Red Army’s advance detachment seized Anshunchang by night; on 25 May seventeen heroes forced the Dadu River. Because there were too few boats, the main force moved north along both banks, and on 29 May the Fourth Regiment seized Luding Bridge, allowing the main force to cross. The campaign foiled Chiang Kai-shek’s attempt to repeat Shi Dakai’s destruction and opened the route to western Sichuan. Anshunchang, the Dashubao feint, the Moxi meeting, and Luding Bridge are separate events.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月，川军第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营防守安顺场北岸渡口，另有“彝务指挥官”邓秀廷部两个连协同。守军收缴南岸船只、在北岸修筑碉堡，并在南岸安顺场堆积柴草准备烧街。24 日夜红军袭占安顺场，守军未能及时纵火；25 日红军十七勇士强渡，赵章成炮火摧毁北岸碉堡，守军溃退。本坐标为安顺场北岸滩头代表点，具体碉堡位置待考。 In May 1935, one battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army defended the north bank at Anshunchang, with two companies under the “Yi affairs commander” Deng Xiuting. The defenders collected boats on the south bank, built blockhouses on the north bank, and piled combustibles in Anshunchang to burn the street. The Red Army seized Anshunchang on the night of 24 May before the defenders could set fires; on 25 May the seventeen heroes crossed, Zhao Zhangcheng’s shellfire destroyed the north-bank blockhouses, and the defenders fled. The coordinate is a representative point on the north bank; the exact blockhouse sites await verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团袭占安顺场，夺得木船一只。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批强渡大渡河，在赵章成炮火掩护下击溃北岸守军，占领桃子湾渡口。随后红军在安靖坝又找到两只船，77 名船工连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，把主力送过河。安顺场由此成为长征中“翼王悲剧地、红军胜利场”的标志性渡口。本坐标为安顺场渡口代表点。 On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang and captured a wooden boat. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian led seventeen heroes across in two groups; covered by Zhao Zhangcheng’s artillery, they routed the north-bank defenders and took the Taozhiwan landing. Two more boats were found at Anjingba, and 77 boatmen ferried the main force for seven days and nights. Anshunchang became the emblematic crossing where the Red Army avoided Shi Dakai’s fate. The coordinate is a representative point at the ferry.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月，国民党军以川军第二十四军刘文辉部守大渡河上游，杨森第二十军等守富林至雅安一线，重点东重西轻。第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营守安顺场北岸，第四旅第三十八团两个营守泸定城与泸定桥，另有地方民团协同。红军以大树堡佯攻牵制富林方向，主力从安顺场强渡并夺取泸定桥，突破了大渡河防线。本坐标为安顺场代表点，防线范围沿大渡河展开。 In May 1935, Liu Wenhui’s Sichuan 24th Army held the upper Dadu River while Yang Sen’s 20th Army and other units held the Fulin–Ya’an sector, with the strongest defenses in the east. One battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, 24th Army held the north bank at Anshunchang, and two battalions of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, held Luding town and bridge, supported by local militia. The Red Army feinted at Dashubao to pin forces at Fulin, then forced the river at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the defense line. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the line extended along the Dadu River.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团冒雨急行军袭占安顺场，歼灭守敌两个连，夺得翘首木船一只，控制南岸渡口。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批从安顺场渡口登船，在轻重机枪和迫击炮掩护下强渡；赵章成以两发炮弹摧毁北岸碉堡，勇士们占领桃子湾渡口。随后 77 名船工用 3 只木船连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，将主力送过大渡河。渡口现存“红军渡”石碑、强渡大渡河纪念碑与指挥楼。本坐标为安顺场镇渡口代表点，具体起渡点待实测。 On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang, destroyed two enemy companies, captured a wooden boat, and controlled the south bank. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian, commander of the 1st Battalion, led seventeen heroes across in two groups from Anshunchang Ferry under machine-gun and mortar cover; Zhao Zhangcheng knocked out the north-bank blockhouses with two shells, and the heroes took the Taozhiwan landing. Some 77 boatmen then ferried the main force across in three boats for seven days and nights. The “Red Army Crossing” stone, the memorial, and the command tower remain. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the exact launching point awaits verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 28 日，川军第二十四军第四旅第三十八团（团长李全山）第三营（营长周桂山）奉命连夜赶赴泸定，拆去泸定桥大部分桥板，在东桥头构筑机枪、迫击炮阵地，并准备煤油烧桥。29 日下午红四团发起夺桥战斗，二十二名勇士攀踏铁索冲击，守军点燃东桥头大火，红军冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。本坐标为泸定桥东桥头代表点，具体阵地待实测。 On 28 May 1935, the 3rd Battalion of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army (regimental commander Li Quanshan; battalion commander Zhou Guishan) rushed to Luding, removed most of the bridge planks, built machine-gun and mortar positions at the east bridgehead, and prepared kerosene to burn the bridge. On the afternoon of 29 May the Fourth Regiment attacked; twenty-two heroes advanced along the iron chains, the defenders set the east bridgehead ablaze, and the Red Army broke through the flames, taking Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The coordinate is a representative point at the east bridgehead; the exact positions await verification.

fields.summary: 红军二十二勇士攀踏铁索夺取泸定桥，打开北上通道。 Twenty-two heroes seized Luding Bridge along its iron chains, opening the route north.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 29 日，红四团在团长黄开湘（一作王开湘）、政委杨成武率领下，一昼夜急行军 240 里赶到泸定桥西桥头。下午 4 时，二连连长廖大珠率二十二名勇士攀踏被抽去桥板的十三根铁索，冒着东桥头火力冲击；守军点燃桥头大火，勇士们冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。红四团伤亡 4 人，中央红军主力随后由泸定桥过大渡河。本坐标为泸定桥代表点。 On 29 May 1935, the Fourth Regiment under Huang Kaixiang (also written Wang Kaixiang) and political commissar Yang Chengwu reached the west end of Luding Bridge after a 240-li forced march in a day and night. At 4 p.m., Liao Dazhu, commander of the 2nd Company, led twenty-two heroes along the thirteen iron chains stripped of planks, under fire from the east bridgehead. The defenders set the bridgehead ablaze; the heroes charged through the flames and took Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The Fourth Regiment suffered four casualties, and the main force crossed the Dadu River at Luding. The coordinate is a representative point at the bridge.

place.zh: 四川泸定磨西镇天主教堂

summary.zh: 毛泽东在磨西天主教堂召集会议，确定有序通过泸定桥与北上安排。
summary.en: Mao Zedong convened a meeting at the Moxi Catholic Church, deciding on the orderly crossing of Luding Bridge and the route north.

fields.name: 磨西会议 Moxi Meeting 磨西天主教堂会议 Moxi Catholic Church Meeting
fields.place: 四川泸定磨西镇天主教堂 Moxi Catholic Church, Luding, Sichuan
fields.summary: 毛泽东在磨西天主教堂召集会议，确定有序通过泸定桥与北上安排。 Mao Zedong convened a meeting at the Moxi Catholic Church, deciding on the orderly crossing of Luding Bridge and the route north.
fields.description: 1935 年 5 月 29 日晚，毛泽东随中央军委机关抵达泸定磨西，宿营磨西天主教堂神甫楼，并召集朱德、周恩来、张闻天、王稼祥、陈云、秦邦宪等开会。会议决定红军不去康定，通知部队有序通过泸定桥、先过人后过马，派陈云出川赴上海恢复党组织并转赴苏联，同时抓紧筹粮，并准备到泸定后研究北上路线。会议日期另有 5 月 28 日说，参加人员记载亦有出入，本条目从 29 日说并只列主要与会者。5 月 30 日凌晨毛泽东离开磨西，行至摩岗岭接到红四团夺取泸定桥的捷报。 On the evening of 29 May 1935, Mao Zedong reached Moxi in Luding with the Central Military Commission office and stayed at the priest’s house of the Moxi Catholic Church. He convened Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, Zhang Wentian, Wang Jiaxiang, Chen Yun, Qin Bangxian, and others. The meeting decided not to go to Kangding; to move troops across Luding Bridge in order, men before horses; to send Chen Yun to Shanghai to restore the party organization and then to the Soviet Union; to collect grain; and to discuss the route north after reaching Luding. Some accounts date the meeting to 28 May and differ on attendees; this entry follows 29 May and lists only the main participants. Mao left Moxi before dawn on 30 May and received news of the bridge’s capture near Mogangling.

fields.description: 1935 年 6 月，中央红军翻越海拔 4000 多米的夹金山，许多战士因严寒缺氧牺牲。 In June 1935, the Central Red Army crossed Jiajin Mountain, more than 4,000 meters above sea level. Many soldiers died from cold and lack of oxygen.

fields.name: 达维会师 Dawei Meeting of Forces 达维会合 Dawei Junction 夹金山下的会师 Meeting below Jiajin Mountain
fields.place: 四川小金达维镇 Dawei, Xiaojin, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红一军团第二师第四团与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团在达维会师。 The Fourth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, met the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army at Dawei.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 12 日，中央红军先头部队红一军团第二师第四团翻越夹金山后，在达维以南、夹金山北麓木城沟与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团相遇，双方吹号联络确认身份，在达维会师桥会合。6 月 17 日，毛泽东、周恩来、朱德等率中央机关到达达维，红二十五师列队迎接；6 月 18 日中央红军主力到达懋功，与红四方面军主力会师。本坐标为达维会师桥代表点。 On 12 June 1935, the Fourth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, crossed the Jiajin Mountains and met the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army at Mucheng Gully below the mountain south of Dawei. The two sides identified each other by bugle calls and joined at the Dawei meeting bridge. On 17 June Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, and the central organs reached Dawei, where the 25th Division lined the road to welcome them; on 18 June the main force reached Maogong and met the main force of the Fourth Front Army. The coordinate is a representative point at the Dawei meeting bridge.

fields.name: 两河口会议 Lianghekou Meeting 两河口政治局扩大会议 Lianghekou Enlarged Politburo Meeting 懋功两河口会议 Lianghekou Meeting at Maogong
fields.place: 四川小金两河口镇 Lianghekou, Xiaojin, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在两河口决定集中主力北上，创造川陕甘根据地。 The Politburo met at Lianghekou and decided to concentrate the main force northward to create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu base area.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 26 日，中央政治局在懋功以北两河口召开扩大会议，通过《关于一、四方面军会合后战略方针的决定》，决定集中主力向北进攻，在运动战中消灭敌人，首先取得甘肃南部，创造川陕甘苏区根据地。张国焘在会上表示同意，会后以“组织问题”为由拖延北上。本坐标为两河口镇代表点，会议会址待进一步落位。 On 26 June 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Lianghekou north of Maogong and adopted the “Decision on the Strategic Policy after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”. It decided to concentrate the main force for a northward attack, destroy the enemy in mobile warfare, first take southern Gansu, and create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu Soviet base. Zhang Guotao agreed at the meeting but afterwards delayed the northward move on the pretext of “organizational questions”. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou; the meeting site awaits further placement.

summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed Mengbi Mountain and continued north toward Zhuokeji and Lianghekou.

fields.summary: 中央红军翻越梦笔山，继续北上卓克基、两河口方向。 The Central Red Army crossed Mengbi Mountain and continued north toward Zhuokeji and Lianghekou.
fields.description: 1935 年 6 月 26 日两河口会议后，中央红军于 6 月 27 日由两河口北上，翻越梦笔山垭口（海拔约 4080—4114 米），进入马尔康卓克基一带。梦笔山是小金与马尔康的界山，红四方面军部队此后亦曾翻越。本坐标为梦笔山垭口代表点。 After the Lianghekou meeting of 26 June 1935, the Central Red Army moved north from Lianghekou on 27 June and crossed the Mengbi Mountain pass (about 4,080–4,114 m) into the Zhuokeji area of Maerkang. Mengbi Mountain lies on the Xiaojin–Maerkang border; Fourth Front Army units also crossed it later. The coordinate is a representative point at the Mengbi pass.

fields.summary: 反“围剿”中连克六座县城，陕甘边与陕北苏区连成一片。 Six county seats were taken, linking the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月至 6 月，红二十六军、红二十七军在第二次反“围剿”中先后攻克安定、延长、延川、安塞、保安、靖边等县城，使陕甘边与陕北苏区连成一片。县城名单为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From February to June 1935, the 26th and 27th Red Armies took Anding, Yanchang, Yanchuan, Ansai, Bao’an and Jingbian county seats during the second counter-encirclement campaign, linking the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas. fields.description: 1935 年 7 月起，国民党军以东北军第 67 军王以哲等部为主，对陕甘苏区发动第三次“围剿”，企图在红二十五军、中央红军到达前消灭陕北红军。第 110 师等部随后在劳山、直罗镇被歼。兵力与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From July 1935, Kuomintang forces led by Wang Yizhe’s Northeast Army 67th Corps launched a third encirclement campaign against the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area, seeking to destroy the northern Shaanxi Red Army before the arrival of the 25th Army and the Central Red Army; the 110th Division and others were later destroyed at Laoshan and Zhiluozhen. Unit designations follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

The 25th Army reached Yongping in September and the Central Red Army reached Wuqi in October. Troop strengths and start/end months follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Designations and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 2 日，红一方面军第一军团和红四方面军第三十军各一部组成先头部队，翻越雅克夏雪山（长板山、马塘梁子，垭口海拔约 4443—4460 米），到达黑水马河坝；7 月 9 日，红一方面军主力及红四方面军一部翻越此山进入黑水，随后进抵芦花。本坐标为雅克夏山垭口代表点。 On 2 July 1935 an advance detachment formed from the First Army Corps of the First Front Army and part of the 30th Army of the Fourth Front Army crossed Yakexia Snow Mountain (Changban Mountain, Matang Liangzi; pass about 4,443–4,460 m) and reached Maheba in Heishui. On 9 July the main force of the First Front Army and part of the Fourth Front Army crossed into Heishui and advanced to Luhua. The coordinate is a representative point at the Yakexia pass.

fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 7 日，红军由打古一带出发，翻越达古山（打古山、拖罗岗，垭口海拔约 4484—4752 米）向毛儿盖前进。达古山位于黑水县境内，是中央红军长征中翻越的海拔最高的雪山之一。本坐标为达古山垭口代表点。 On 7 July 1935 the Red Army set out from the Dagu area and crossed Dagu Mountain (Dagu, Tuoluogang; pass about 4,484–4,752 m) toward Maoergai. Dagu Mountain lies in Heishui county and was one of the highest snow mountains crossed by the Central Red Army during the Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Dagu pass.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。

fields.name: 芦花会议 Luhua Meeting 黑水芦花会议 Luhua Meeting at Heishui 芦花政治局会议 Luhua Politburo Meeting
fields.place: 四川黑水芦花镇 Luhua, Heishui, Sichuan
fields.summary: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。 The Politburo met at Luhua to settle unified command and the work of the Fourth Front Army.
fields.description: 1935 年 7 月 18 日，中央政治局常委会议在芦花召开，同意周恩来辞去红军总政委，任命张国焘为红军总政委、军委总负责者；7 月 21—22 日政治局扩大会议听取张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩关于红四方面军的报告，肯定其成绩，批评退出鄂豫皖、放弃通南巴等错误，并决定组织前敌总指挥部，徐向前任总指挥、陈昌浩任政委、叶剑英任参谋长。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，会址待进一步落位。 On 18 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee met at Luhua and agreed that Zhou Enlai should resign as political commissar of the Red Army, appointing Zhang Guotao as political commissar and head of the Military Commission. On 21–22 July an enlarged Politburo meeting heard reports from Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao on the Fourth Front Army, affirmed its achievements, criticized errors including the withdrawal from the Hubei–Henan–Anhui base and the abandonment of Tongnanba, and decided to form the Front Command with Xu Xiangqian as commander, Chen Changhao as political commissar, and Ye Jianying as chief of staff. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua; the meeting site awaits further placement.

fields.name: 沙窝会议 Shawo Meeting 毛儿盖沙窝会议 Shawo Meeting at Maoergai 沙窝政治局扩大会议 Shawo Enlarged Politburo Meeting

fields.summary: 中央政治局在沙窝开会，重申北上方针，首次以中央文件使用“长征”一词。 The Politburo met at Shawo, reaffirmed the northward policy, and first used the term “Long March” in a central document.
fields.description: 1935 年 8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖附近沙窝（俄灯寨）召开扩大会议，讨论红一、四方面军会合后的形势与任务及组织问题；通过《关于一、四方面军会合后的政治形势与任务的决议》，重申两河口会议北上方针，强调党对红军的绝对领导和两军团结，增补陈昌浩、周纯全为政治局委员。决议中“红军一万八千里长征”是中央文件首次正式使用“长征”一词。本坐标为俄灯寨代表点。 From 4 to 6 August 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Shawo (Edengzhai) near Maoergai to discuss the situation and tasks after the meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies, as well as organizational questions. It adopted the “Resolution on the Political Situation and Tasks after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”, reaffirmed the northward policy of the Lianghekou meeting, stressed absolute Party leadership over the Red Army and unity between the two armies, and added Chen Changhao and Zhou Chunquan to the Politburo. The phrase “the Red Army’s 18,000-li Long March” in the resolution was the first formal use of “Long March” in a central document. The coordinate is a representative point at Edengzhai.

fields.summary: 中央在巴西召开紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军连夜北上。 The central leadership held an emergency meeting at Baxi and decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps north that night.
fields.description: 1935 年 9 月 9 日，张国焘电令右路军南下，叶剑英获取密电后报告毛泽东。毛泽东、张闻天、博古等赶到红三军团驻地巴西，连夜召开政治局紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军和军委纵队一部立即北上，脱离险境，并发布《为执行北上方针告同志书》。9 月 10 日凌晨，中央率部离开巴西，向俄界前进。本坐标为巴西镇班佑寺代表点，阿西牙弄紧急会议会址待分别落位。 On 9 September 1935 Zhang Guotao telegraphed the right column to move south. Ye Jianying obtained the telegram and reported it to Mao Zedong. Mao, Zhang Wentian, and Bo Gu rushed to the Third Army Corps headquarters at Baxi and held an emergency Politburo meeting that night. They decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps and part of the CMC column north immediately to escape the danger, and issued the “Letter to Comrades on Carrying Out the Northward Policy”. In the early hours of 10 September the central leadership left Baxi for Ejie. The coordinate is a representative point at Banyou Temple, Baxi; the Axi Yanong emergency meeting site awaits separate placement.

summary.en: The Politburo met at Ejie, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and reorganized the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment.

fields.summary: 中央政治局在俄界通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，整编陕甘支队。 The Politburo met at Ejie, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and reorganized the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment.
fields.description: 1935 年 9 月 12 日，中央政治局在甘肃迭部俄界（今高吉村）召开扩大会议，听取毛泽东关于与四方面军领导者争论及今后战略方针的报告，通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，决定将红一、红三军和军委纵队整编为中国工农红军陕甘支队，彭德怀任司令员、毛泽东任政委，并成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥、彭德怀、林彪组成的五人团。本坐标为高吉村代表点，会址待进一步落位。 On 12 September 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Ejie (now Gaoji Village) in Diebu, Gansu. It heard Mao Zedong’s report on the dispute with the Fourth Front Army leadership and future strategy, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and decided to reorganize the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column into the Chinese Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment, with Peng Dehuai as commander and Mao Zedong as political commissar. It also formed a five-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Wang Jiaxiang, Peng Dehuai, and Lin Biao. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaoji Village; the meeting site awaits further placement.

fields.summary: 陕甘支队在青石嘴突袭东北军骑兵运输队，缴获战马百余匹。 The Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment raided an Northeast Army cavalry supply column at Qingshizui, capturing over 100 horses.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 7 日，陕甘支队翻越六盘山后，前卫在青石嘴附近抓获敌军便衣侦察员，得知东北军骑兵第七师第十九团两个连正在青石嘴休整。毛泽东决定突袭，以第四大队正面攻击、第一和第五大队两翼迂回、第十三大队后卫掩护，经约半小时战斗，歼敌 200 余人，缴获战马 100 余匹及大批弹药。红军以此组建第一支骑兵侦察连。本坐标为青石嘴村代表点，具体战场待考。 On 7 October 1935, after crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s advance guard captured enemy plainclothes scouts near Qingshizui and learned that two companies of the 19th Regiment, 7th Cavalry Division, Northeast Army, were resting there. Mao Zedong ordered a surprise attack: the 4th Battalion attacked frontally, the 1st and 5th Battalions swept the flanks, and the 13th Battalion covered the rear. In about half an hour the Red Army killed or wounded more than 200 enemy soldiers and captured over 100 horses and large quantities of ammunition. The captured horses were used to form the Red Army’s first cavalry reconnaissance company. The coordinate is a representative point at Qingshizui village; the exact battlefield awaits verification.

fields.summary: 红四方面军南下，攻占绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功。 The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 8 日至 20 日，红四方面军执行《绥丹崇懋战役计划》，王树声率右纵队沿大金川南下夺取绥靖、丹巴，徐向前、陈昌浩率左纵队沿抚边河南下夺取懋功、达维。经 12 天战斗，击溃川军 6 个旅，占领绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功等地，为南下天全、芦山打开通道。本坐标为丹巴县城代表点，绥靖、崇化、懋功待分别落位。 From 8 to 20 October 1935, the Fourth Front Army carried out the “Suidan Chongmao Campaign Plan”. Wang Shusheng led the right column south along the Dajin River to take Suijing and Danba, while Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao led the left column south along the Fubian River to take Maogong and Dawei. In twelve days of fighting they routed six Sichuan brigades and occupied Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong, opening the way south to Tianquan and Lushan. The coordinate is a representative point at Danba county town; Suijing, Chonghua, and Maogong await separate placement.

fields.name: 切尾巴战役 “Cutting the Tail” Battle 吴起镇战役 Battle of Wuqi Town 长征最后一战 Last Battle of the Long March

fields.summary: 中央红军在吴起镇击退尾追骑兵，结束长征最后一战。 The Central Red Army defeated the pursuing cavalry at Wuqi, the last battle of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达吴起镇，国民党军骑兵追至苏区门口。20 日，红军在头道川、平台山、二道川、三道川设伏；21 日发起“切尾巴”战役，分块切割、相机包围，歼灭东北军白凤翔第六师一个骑兵团、郭希鹏第三师两个骑兵团，击溃马鸿宾部第三十五师马培清骑兵团，毙伤 600 余人，俘 1000 余人，缴获战马、驮马 1600 余匹。此役是中央红军结束长征的最后一战。本坐标为吴起镇代表点。 On 19 October 1935 the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, with KMT cavalry pursuing to the gate of the Soviet area. On 20 October the Red Army set ambushes at Toudao Creek, Pingtai Mountain, Erdao Creek, and Sandao Creek; on 21 October it launched the “Cutting the Tail” battle, cutting the enemy into blocks and encircling them. It destroyed one cavalry regiment of Bai Fengxiang’s 6th Division and two cavalry regiments of Guo Xipeng’s 3rd Division, routed Ma Peiqing’s cavalry regiment of Ma Hongbin’s 35th Division, killed or wounded more than 600, captured more than 1,000, and took over 1,600 horses and pack animals. The battle was the last of the Central Red Army’s Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Wuqi.

summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.

fields.place: 四川芦山县城 Lushan county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军南下攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山，百丈关受挫。 The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 24 日至 11 月 25 日，红四方面军分左、中、右纵队从懋功、丹巴等地南下，攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山等地，歼敌 1 万余人，击落飞机 1 架。11 月中旬进攻百丈关，遭川军 80 余团反扑，激战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万人，被迫撤至天全、芦山、宝兴休整。此役是红四方面军南下由进攻转入防御的转折点。本坐标为芦山县城代表点。 From 24 October to 25 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army moved south in left, center, and right columns from Maogong and Danba, taking Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, destroying more than 10,000 enemy troops, and downing one aircraft. In mid-November it attacked Baizhang Pass but was counterattacked by more than 80 Sichuan regiments; after seven days and nights of fighting it suffered nearly 10,000 casualties and withdrew to Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing. The campaign marked the Fourth Front Army’s shift from offensive to defensive in the south. The coordinate is a representative point at Lushan county town.

fields.description: 1935 年 10 月 25 日，红十五军团在陕西甘泉榆林桥歼灭国民党军第 107 师第 619 团及第 620 团一部，俘团长高福源。番号与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On October 25, 1935, the Red 15th Army Corps destroyed the 619th Regiment and part of the 620th Regiment of the KMT 107th Division at Yulinqiao, Ganquan, Shaanxi, capturing regimental commander Gao Fuyuan. Designations and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.

fields.place: 四川名山百丈镇 Baizhang, Mingshan, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军在百丈关与川军决战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万，南下受挫。 The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 13 日至 21 日，红四方面军以 15 个团向名山、邛崃间百丈关进攻，16 日占领百丈镇。川军刘湘调集 80 余团，在飞机大炮掩护下从北、东、南三面反扑。红军在百丈周围十余里弧形阵地浴血苦战 7 昼夜，毙伤川军 1.5 万余人，自身伤亡近万人，被迫撤出百丈，转入防御。本坐标为百丈镇代表点。 From 13 to 21 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army attacked Baizhang Pass between Mingshan and Qionglai with fifteen regiments and took Baizhang town on 16 November. Liu Xiang concentrated more than eighty Sichuan regiments and counterattacked from north, east, and south under air and artillery cover. The Red Army fought for seven days and nights in an arc-shaped position around Baizhang, killing or wounding more than 15,000 Sichuan troops while suffering nearly 10,000 casualties, and was forced to withdraw and go on the defensive. The coordinate is a representative point at Baizhang town.

summary.en: Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.

fields.summary: 国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团。 Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.
fields.description: 1935 年 11 月至 1936 年 10 月，国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团，企图将其围歼于湘鄂川黔地区；红军突围西进，最终与红四方面军会师。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From November 1935 to October 1936, Kuomintang forces including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups, seeking to destroy them in the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou region; the Red Army broke out westward and eventually joined the Red Fourth Front Army. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 11 月 21 日至 24 日，红一方面军在陕西富县直罗镇歼灭国民党东北军第 109 师等部，为党中央把革命大本营放在西北奠定了基础。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From November 21 to 24, 1935, the First Front Army destroyed the KMT Northeast Army’s 109th Division and other units at Zhiluozhen, Fu County, Shaanxi, laying the foundation for the Party Central Committee to establish its base in the northwest. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 湖南芷江便水（上坪一带）

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.

fields.name: 便水战役 Battle of Bianshui 便水战斗 Bianshui Battle 芷江便水之战 Bianshui Battle near Zhijiang
fields.place: 湖南芷江便水（上坪一带） Bianshui, Zhijiang, Hunan (Shangping area)
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。 The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.
fields.description: 1936 年 1 月 5 日至 6 日，红二、红六军团在芷江、晃县间便水地区伏击尾追的湘军李觉纵队第十六师。因敌军提前侦察、伏击意图暴露，战斗转为阵地拉锯战；红军毙伤俘敌近千人，自身亦有较大伤亡，红四师参谋长金承忠、十一团团长覃耀楚牺牲。6 日黄昏撤出战斗，向黔东转移。本坐标为便水/上坪代表点。 From 5 to 6 January 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the pursuing 16th Division of Li Jue’s Hunan column at Bianshui between Zhijiang and Huangxian. Enemy reconnaissance exposed the ambush, and the battle became a positional struggle. The Red Army killed, wounded, or captured nearly 1,000 enemy troops but also suffered heavy casualties; Jin Chengzhong, chief of staff of the Fourth Division, and Qin Yaochu, commander of the 11th Regiment, were killed. The Red Army withdrew at dusk on 6 January and moved toward eastern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at Bianshui/Shangping.

place.zh: 贵州黔西鸭池河古渡口

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团从鸭池河渡口渡过乌江上游，进占黔西。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps crossed the upper Wu River at Yachihe and entered western Guizhou.

fields.name: 鸭池河渡口 Yachihe Ferry 鸭池河渡口 Yachi River Crossing 红军强渡鸭池河 Forcing the Yachi River
fields.place: 贵州黔西鸭池河古渡口 Yachihe old ferry, Qianxi, Guizhou
fields.summary: 红二、红六军团从鸭池河渡口渡过乌江上游，进占黔西。 The Second and Sixth Army Corps crossed the upper Wu River at Yachihe and entered western Guizhou.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月 2 日，红二、红六军团先头部队奔袭鸭池河渡口，控制南岸，缴获木船 4 只，在船工帮助下连夜架设浮桥，1.8 万余人用 3 天渡过鸭池河，进占黔西、大定、毕节，打开黔西北大门。本坐标为鸭池河古渡口代表点。 On 2 February 1936, the advance guard of the Second and Sixth Army Corps rushed the Yachihe ferry, secured the south bank, captured four wooden boats, and with local boatmen built a pontoon bridge overnight. More than 18,000 troops crossed the Yachi River over three days and entered Qianxi, Dading, and Bijie, opening the door to northwestern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at the old Yachihe ferry.

summary.zh: 红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴，经丹巴、道孚、炉霍、甘孜二次北上。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.

fields.name: 红四方面军二次北上 The Fourth Front Army’s Second Move North 红四方面军再次北上 The Fourth Front Army Moves North Again 康道炉战役 Kang-Dao-Lu Campaign
fields.place: 四川甘孜县城 Ganzi county town, Sichuan
fields.summary: 红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴，经丹巴、道孚、炉霍、甘孜二次北上。 The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.
fields.description: 1936 年 2 月中旬，红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴地区，再次翻越夹金山，经达维、懋功、丹巴向西转移；3 月 1 日先头部队攻占道孚，15 日占炉霍，随后占领甘孜。7 月初与红二、六军团在甘孜会师，随后共同北上。本坐标为甘孜县城代表点，具体行军路线待细化。 In mid-February 1936 the Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing, crossed the Jiajin Mountains again, and moved west via Dawei, Maogong, and Danba. On 1 March its advance guard took Daofu, on 15 March Luhuo, and then Ganzi. In early July it met the Second and Sixth Army Corps at Ganzi and moved north together. The coordinate is a representative point at Ganzi county town; the exact route awaits refinement.

fields.description: 1936 年 3 月 30 日夜，红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼召开会议，传达红军总部电示，分析全国形势，决定放弃在南北盘江建立根据地，立即北渡金沙江，与红四方面军会合、共同北上抗日。4 月 1 日撤离盘县。本坐标为九间楼代表点。 On the night of 30 March 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian. They relayed the Red Army headquarters’ instructions, analyzed the national situation, and decided to abandon plans for a base between the north and south Pan rivers. Instead they would cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army and move north together to resist Japan. They left Panxian on 1 April. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiujianlou.

summary.en: The Second Army Corps seized the Pudu River crossing and fought the Yunnan army, but the crossing was blocked.

fields.name: 普渡河战斗 Battle of the Pudu River 普渡河渡口战斗 Pudu River Crossing Battle 普渡河铁索桥战斗 Pudu River Chain Bridge Battle
fields.place: 云南禄劝普渡河铁索桥 Pudu River chain bridge, Luquan, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红二军团抢占普渡河渡口，与滇军激战，渡河受阻。 The Second Army Corps seized the Pudu River crossing and fought the Yunnan army, but the crossing was blocked.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 8 日，红二军团第四师先头部队抢占禄劝普渡河渡口，与滇军孙渡纵队激战；红四师大部从铁索桥下涉水过河，红六军团前卫第十七师在普渡河与滇军遭遇，渡河受阻。红军被迫调整部署，转至六甲阻击。本坐标为普渡河铁索桥代表点。 On 8 April 1936, the advance guard of the Fourth Division, Second Army Corps, seized the Pudu River crossing in Luquan and fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column. Most of the Fourth Division forded the river below the chain bridge, while the Seventeenth Division, vanguard of the Sixth Army Corps, met the Yunnan troops at the Pudu River and was blocked. The Red Army adjusted its deployment and turned to block the enemy at Liujia. The coordinate is a representative point at the Pudu River chain bridge.

fields.name: 六甲阻击战 Liujia Blocking Battle 六甲之战 Battle of Liujia 贾白山阻击战 Jiabaishan Blocking Battle
fields.place: 云南寻甸六甲贾白山 Liujia, Jiabaishan, Xundian, Yunnan
fields.summary: 红六师在六甲阻击滇军，掩护主力西进。 The Sixth Division blocked the Yunnan army at Liujia, covering the main force’s westward move.
fields.description: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，红二军团第六师在寻甸六甲石蜡坨垭口阻击尾追的滇军第七旅，红十六、十七、十八团抢占垭口南北山冈，激战至傍晚，红五师增援从侧后夹击，滇军溃退。红军以伤亡 200 余人代价歼敌近千人，粉碎滇军将红军消灭于普渡河以东、功山以南的计划。本坐标为六甲/贾白山代表点。 On 9 April 1936, the Sixth Division of the Second Army Corps blocked the pursuing 7th Brigade of the Yunnan army at the Shilatuo pass in Liujia, Xundian. The 16th, 17th, and 18th Regiments seized the high ground north and south of the pass and fought until evening, when the Fifth Division arrived and attacked the enemy flank and rear, routing the Yunnan troops. The Red Army suffered more than 200 casualties and killed or wounded nearly 1,000 enemy soldiers, foiling the plan to destroy the Red Army east of the Pudu River and south of Gongshan. The coordinate is a representative point at Liujia/Jiabaishan.

fields.name: 中法战争 The Sino-French War
fields.summary: 法国舰队袭击马尾，福建水师覆没。 The French fleet attacked Mawei and destroyed the Fujian fleet.
fields.description: 1884 年，中法战争爆发，法国舰队在马尾袭击福建水师，福建水师几乎全军覆没；清军随后在镇南关等地取得胜利，最终签订《中法新约》。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1884 the Sino-French War broke out. The French fleet attacked the Fujian fleet at Mawei, almost annihilating it; Qing forces later won at Zhennanguan, and the war ended with the Treaty of Tianjin. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Briefly rated the strongest in Asia, it later suffered from declining funding and training. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Battle of Pungdo began the First Sino-Japanese War, and the Qing were defeated.

After defeats on land and sea, the Qing signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 日军进攻成欢，清军败退牙山。 Japanese forces attacked Seonghwan and drove the Qing army back to Asan.

After defeat the Qing troops withdrew toward Asan, with Nie Shicheng’s units breaking out, opening the land war of 1894–95. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

After a day of fighting they were defeated and withdrew north of the Yalu, and the war in Korea turned sharply against China. fields.name: 黄海海战 The Battle of the Yellow Sea

After hours of fighting the Chinese fleet lost several ships and command of the Yellow Sea. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 马关条约 The Treaty of Shimonoseki
fields.summary: 李鸿章与日本签订《马关条约》。 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Japan.
fields.description: 1895 年 4 月，李鸿章在日本马关与日方签订《马关条约》，割让台湾、澎湖与辽东半岛，赔款二亿两，允许日本在华设厂，震动朝野。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In April 1895 Li Hongzhang signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki at Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan, the Penghu Islands, and the Liaodong Peninsula, imposing a 200-million-tael indemnity, and permitting Japanese factories in China, shocking the Qing court and public. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Taiwanese and Qing forces fought through Taipei, Hsinchu, Miaoli, Changhua, and Tainan until the fall of Tainan in October. fields.summary: 清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》。 The Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution.
fields.description: 1908 年，清廷颁布《钦定宪法大纲》，规定君上大权，并以九年为预备立宪期限，被立宪派批评为“假立宪”。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1908 the Qing court issued the Principles of the Constitution, preserving broad imperial powers and setting a nine-year preparatory period. Constitutionalists criticized it as “fake constitutionalism.” Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1909 年 1 月，清廷颁布《城镇乡地方自治章程》，推行地方自治，设立议事会与董事会，为立宪派参与地方政治提供制度空间。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1909 the Qing promulgated regulations on local self-government in towns and villages, establishing councils and boards and giving constitutionalists an institutional foothold in local politics. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 各省咨议局成立，立宪派进入地方政治。 Provincial assemblies were established, bringing constitutionalists into local politics.
fields.description: 1909 年，清廷在各省设立咨议局，作为地方议事机构，立宪派借此扩大政治影响，推动召开国会请愿运动。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1909 the Qing established provincial assemblies as local deliberative bodies. Constitutionalists used them to expand political influence and press for a national parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The petition movement for a parliament

summary.zh: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。
summary.en: Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.

fields.name: 国会请愿运动 The petition movement for a parliament
fields.summary: 各省代表赴京请愿，要求速开国会。 Provincial delegates petitioned Beijing for an early national parliament.
fields.description: 1910 年，各省咨议局与商会、教育会等团体发起三次国会请愿运动，要求缩短预备立宪期限、速开国会，清廷仅小幅让步，立宪派日益失望。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1910 provincial assemblies, chambers of commerce, and educational associations launched three petition campaigns demanding that the Qing shorten the preparatory period and convene a parliament. The court made only minor concessions, and constitutionalists grew increasingly disillusioned. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The election of the Advisory Council

summary.zh: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。
summary.en: After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.

fields.name: 资政院选举 The election of the Advisory Council
fields.summary: 资政院议员选举后开院，立宪派进入中央议事机构。 After elections, the Advisory Council opened, bringing constitutionalists into a central deliberative body.
fields.description: 1909 年各省选举资政院议员，1910 年 10 月资政院开院，成为清末立宪派参与中央政治的重要平台，但权限有限，未能满足速开国会的要求。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1909 the provinces elected members of the Advisory Council, which opened in October 1910 as a central deliberative body for constitutionalists. Its powers were limited, however, and it failed to satisfy demands for a parliament. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1910 年 12 月，资政院第一次常年会弹劾军机大臣，要求设立责任内阁，与清廷发生正面冲突，显示资政院与皇权的张力。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In December 1910 the Advisory Council’s first annual session impeached the Grand Council and demanded a responsible cabinet, clashing directly with the court and revealing the tension between the council and imperial authority. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dubbed the “Royal Cabinet,” it deeply disappointed constitutionalists and pushed many toward revolution. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.name: 保路运动 The Railway Protection Movement
fields.summary: 四川保路运动爆发，成为辛亥革命导火索。 The Sichuan Railway Protection Movement erupted, helping trigger the 1911 Revolution.
fields.description: 1911 年，清廷宣布铁路国有，激起四川保路运动，清廷调湖北新军入川镇压，削弱了武汉防务，为武昌起义创造了条件。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In 1911 the Qing move to nationalize railways sparked the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. Troops were drawn from Hubei to suppress it, weakening Wuhan’s defenses and creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Wuchang Uprising broke out and provinces across China responded.

fields.description: 1911 年 10 月 10 日，新军在武昌起义，攻占湖广总督署，各省随后纷纷响应，清朝统治迅速瓦解。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。 On 10 October 1911, New Army units rose in Wuchang and seized the Hubei governor’s office. fields.summary: 隋炀帝征高句丽，围攻辽东城不克。 Emperor Yang of Sui campaigned against Goguryeo but failed to take Liaodong.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 751 年，高仙芝率唐军与阿拔斯王朝及葛逻禄联军在怛罗斯交战，因葛逻禄倒戈，唐军大败。此战常被与造纸术西传联系起来，具体细节待史料校订。 In 751, Gao Xianzhi’s Tang army fought an Abbasid and Karluk coalition at Talas. The Karluks switched sides, and the Tang force was routed. The battle is often linked to the westward transmission of papermaking; details await historical review.

Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 唐玄宗西逃途中，禁军在马嵬驿哗变。 The imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post as Emperor Xuanzong fled west.

Emperor Xuanzong fled west, and the imperial guards mutinied at Mawei Post, killing Yang Guozhong and forcing Yang Guifei’s death before the emperor continued to Sichuan. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 张巡、许远坚守睢阳，阻遏叛军南下。 Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang, blocking the rebels’ southward advance.

Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held the city for months before it fell and they died, but their resistance tied down rebel forces and protected the Jiang-Huai revenue region. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

The aftermath left powerful military governors entrenched in Hebei. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Emperor Daizong fled, and the Tibetans withdrew after about fifteen days. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 河朔三镇半独立，形成长期藩镇割据。 The three Hebei garrisons became semi-independent, entrenching long-term military autonomy.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

The plot was exposed and failed; the eunuchs massacred officials in what became known as the Ganlu Incident and thereafter dominated the court. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.summary: 唐武宗下令拆寺汰僧，佛教受到沉重打击。 Emperor Wuzong ordered temples destroyed and monks laicized, dealing a heavy blow to Buddhism.

The campaign is grouped with earlier imperial persecutions of Buddhism. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

He then sent envoys to submit to the Tang, which established the Guiyi Army and made him its military governor. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and was later organized as the West Route Army.

fields.name: 西路军渡黄河 West Route Army Crosses the Yellow River 靖远渡河 Jingyuan River Crossing 虎豹口渡河 Hubaokou Crossing
fields.place: 甘肃靖远虎豹口 Hubaokou, Jingyuan, Gansu
fields.summary: 红四方面军一部从靖远虎豹口西渡黄河，后组建西路军。 Part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and was later organized as the West Route Army.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 24 日夜，红四方面军第 30 军在靖远虎豹口强渡黄河成功；至 28 日，第 30 军、第 9 军和方面军总部渡河；30 日，第 5 军从三角城渡河。渡河部队共 2.18 万余人，11 月 11 日组建西路军，执行宁夏战役与河西作战任务。本坐标为虎豹口渡口代表点。 On the night of 24 October 1936, the 30th Army of the Fourth Front Army forced the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan. By 28 October the 30th Army, 9th Army, and the Fourth Front Army headquarters had crossed; on 30 October the 5th Army crossed at Sanjiaocheng. More than 21,800 troops crossed and were organized as the West Route Army on 11 November to carry out the Ningxia campaign and operations in the Hexi Corridor. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hubaokou ferry.

summary.zh: 西路军在景泰一条山击退马家军，歼敌 1000 余人。
summary.en: The West Route Army repulsed the Ma clique at Yitiaoshan in Jingtai, killing or wounding over 1,000 enemy troops.

fields.name: 一条山战斗 Battle of Yitiaoshan 景泰一条山战斗 Yitiaoshan Battle in Jingtai
fields.place: 甘肃景泰一条山 Yitiaoshan, Jingtai, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军在景泰一条山击退马家军，歼敌 1000 余人。 The West Route Army repulsed the Ma clique at Yitiaoshan in Jingtai, killing or wounding over 1,000 enemy troops.
fields.description: 1936 年 10 月 31 日至 11 月 4 日，红四方面军河西部队占领景泰一条山大部分村寨；11 月 3 日马步芳、马步青集中 3 个骑兵旅、2 个步兵旅猛攻，红军激战三昼夜，歼敌 1000 余人，将敌击退。此役为西路军西进古浪、永昌打开通道。本坐标为一条山镇代表点。 From 31 October to 4 November 1936, the Fourth Front Army’s river-crossing troops occupied most villages at Yitiaoshan in Jingtai. On 3 November Ma Bufang and Ma Buqing concentrated three cavalry brigades and two infantry brigades for a fierce attack; the Red Army fought for three days and nights, killed or wounded more than 1,000 enemy troops, and drove them back. The battle opened the way for the West Route Army’s advance to Gulang and Yongchang. The coordinate is a representative point at Yitiaoshan town.

summary.en: The 9th Army fought a bloody battle with the Ma clique at Gulang, killing or wounding over 2,000 enemy troops while suffering more than 2,400 casualties.

fields.name: 古浪战役 Battle of Gulang 古浪三战 Three Battles of Gulang 古浪血战 Gulang Bloodbath
fields.place: 甘肃古浪县城 Gulang county town, Gansu
fields.summary: 红 9 军在古浪与马家军血战，毙伤敌 2000 余人，自身伤亡 2400 余人。 The 9th Army fought a bloody battle with the Ma clique at Gulang, killing or wounding over 2,000 enemy troops while suffering more than 2,400 casualties.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 11 日至 18 日，红 9 军西进古浪，在干柴洼、横梁山、古浪城与马家军激战；18 日马家军集中骑兵、步兵在飞机大炮掩护下猛攻，红军巷战后撤出。此役毙伤敌 2000 余人，红 9 军伤亡 2400 余人，排以上干部损失严重，有「古浪三战，九军折半」之说。本坐标为古浪县城代表点。 From 11 to 18 November 1936, the 9th Army advanced west to Gulang and fought the Ma clique at Ganchaiwa, Hengliang Mountain, and Gulang town. On 18 November the Ma forces concentrated cavalry and infantry, supported by aircraft and artillery, and stormed the town; the Red Army withdrew after street fighting. The battle killed or wounded more than 2,000 enemy troops, while the 9th Army suffered more than 2,400 casualties, with heavy losses among officers at company level and above; it was said that “three battles at Gulang halved the 9th Army.” The coordinate is a representative point at Gulang county town.

summary.en: The West Route Army established a temporary base at Yongchang and Shandan, fought for forty days, and was reduced to 15,000 troops.

fields.name: 永昌山丹防御 Defense of Yongchang and Shandan 永昌山丹战役 Yongchang–Shandan Campaign 甘北根据地 Ganbei Base Area

fields.summary: 西路军在永昌、山丹建立临时根据地，苦战 40 天，减员至 1.5 万。 The West Route Army established a temporary base at Yongchang and Shandan, fought for forty days, and was reduced to 15,000 troops.
fields.description: 1936 年 11 月 18 日至 12 月 28 日，西路军占领永昌、山丹，在东起凉州西四十里铺、西至山丹的狭长地带建立甘北根据地，与马家军多次激战，歼敌 6000 余人，自身由 2.18 万减至 1.5 万。12 月 28 日突围西进临泽、高台。本坐标为永昌县城代表点。 From 18 November to 28 December 1936, the West Route Army occupied Yongchang and Shandan and established the Ganbei base area in the narrow corridor from west of Liangzhou to Shandan. It fought the Ma clique repeatedly, killing or wounding more than 6,000 enemy troops, while its own strength fell from 21,800 to 15,000. On 28 December it broke out westward toward Linze and Gaotai. The coordinate is a representative point at Yongchang county town.

summary.en: The 5th Army held Gaotai; Dong Zhentang, Yang Keming, and others died, and the town fell.

fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 1 日，红 5 军攻占高台；1 月 12 日马家军集中兵力包围，红军苦战 9 昼夜，1 月 20 日高台失守。军长董振堂、政治部主任杨克明等 2000 余人牺牲。本坐标为高台县城代表点。 On 1 January 1937 the 5th Army captured Gaotai. On 12 January the Ma clique concentrated its forces and besieged the town; after nine days and nights of fighting, Gaotai fell on 20 January. More than 2,000 people, including army commander Dong Zhentang and political department director Yang Keming, were killed. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaotai county town.

summary.en: The 30th Army annihilated the Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment at Xidongbao, its greatest victory in the Hexi Corridor.

fields.name: 西洞堡大捷 Victory at Xidongbao 西洞堡战斗 Battle of Xidongbao 西洞堡歼灭战 Xidongbao Annihilation Battle
fields.place: 甘肃张掖西洞堡、龙首堡一带 Xidongbao and Longshoubao area, Zhangye, Gansu
fields.summary: 红 30 军在西洞堡全歼青海宪兵团，取得河西最大胜利。 The 30th Army annihilated the Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment at Xidongbao, its greatest victory in the Hexi Corridor.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 27 日，红 30 军在西洞堡、龙首堡抓住战机，以第 88、89 师出击，全歼马步芳青海宪兵团，击溃第 100 师手枪团，毙敌 800 余人，缴枪 1200 余支及大批物资。这是西路军进入河西后最大的一次军事胜利。本坐标为西洞堡/龙首堡代表点。 On 27 January 1937, the 30th Army seized the opportunity at Xidongbao and Longshoubao, committing the 88th and 89th Divisions. It annihilated Ma Bufang’s Qinghai Gendarmerie Regiment, routed the 100th Division’s pistol regiment, killed or wounded more than 800 enemy troops, and captured over 1,200 guns and large quantities of supplies. It was the West Route Army’s greatest victory after entering the Hexi Corridor. The coordinate is a representative point at Xidongbao/Longshoubao.

fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 28 日，西路军军政委员会在张掖龙首堡张福寿屯庄召开扩大会议，分析东进受阻形势，决定重建骑兵师、集中兵力重返倪家营，伺机歼敌。本坐标为龙渠/龙首堡代表点。 On 28 January 1937, the West Route Army’s military and political committee held an enlarged meeting at Zhangfushou Farmstead in Longshoubao, Zhangye. It analyzed the blocked eastward route and decided to rebuild the cavalry division and concentrate forces to return to Nijia Yingzi to seek opportunities against the enemy. The coordinate is a representative point at Longqu/Longshoubao.

summary.en: The West Route Army fought the Ma clique at Nijia Yingzi for forty days and nights before breaking out.

fields.name: 倪家营子战斗 Battle of Nijia Yingzi 倪家营子血战 Nijia Yingzi Bloodbath 倪家营子保卫战 Defense of Nijia Yingzi
fields.place: 甘肃临泽倪家营子 Nijia Yingzi, Linze, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军在倪家营子与马家军血战 40 昼夜，被迫突围。 The West Route Army fought the Ma clique at Nijia Yingzi for forty days and nights before breaking out.
fields.description: 1937 年 1 月 31 日至 2 月 27 日，西路军在临泽倪家营子 43 个堡寨与马家军激战，击退多次大规模进攻，歼敌近万人，自身伤亡严重；2 月 27 日突围西进三道柳沟。本坐标为倪家营子代表点。 From 31 January to 27 February 1937, the West Route Army fought the Ma clique in forty-three fortified villages at Nijia Yingzi in Linze. It repulsed several large-scale attacks and killed or wounded nearly 10,000 enemy troops, but suffered heavy casualties itself; on 27 February it broke out westward toward Sandaoliugou. The coordinate is a representative point at Nijia Yingzi.

fields.description: 1937 年 3 月 12 日，西路军在临泽梨园口与尾追马家军骑兵、步兵激战，红 9 军余部与妇女独立团一部几乎全部牺牲，掩护西路军余部进入祁连山。本坐标为梨园口代表点。 On 12 March 1937, the West Route Army fought pursuing Ma clique cavalry and infantry at Liyuankou in Linze. The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment were almost entirely lost, covering the entry of the remaining West Route Army into the Qilian Mountains. The coordinate is a representative point at Liyuankou.

fields.place: 甘肃肃南石窝山 Shiwo Mountain, Sunan, Gansu
fields.summary: 西路军军政委员会在石窝山开会，决定分散游击、徐陈回陕北。 The West Route Army’s military and political committee met at Shiwo Mountain and decided to disperse into guerrilla units, with Xu and Chen returning to northern Shaanxi.
fields.description: 1937 年 3 月 14 日，西路军军政委员会在肃南石窝山召开紧急会议，决定徐向前、陈昌浩离开部队回陕北汇报，余部编为左、右、机动三个支队，组成西路军工作委员会，李先念率左支队向新疆方向转战。本坐标为石窝山代表点。 On 14 March 1937, the West Route Army’s military and political committee held an emergency meeting at Shiwo Mountain in Sunan. It decided that Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao should leave the army and report back to northern Shaanxi; the remaining troops were divided into left, right, and mobile detachments under a West Route Army work committee, with Li Xiannian leading the left detachment toward Xinjiang. The coordinate is a representative point at Shiwo Mountain.

summary.en: The remnants of the West Route Army’s left detachment reached Xingxingxia and met the Central Committee’s representatives.

fields.place: 新疆哈密星星峡 Xingxingxia, Hami, Xinjiang
fields.summary: 西路军左支队余部到达星星峡，与党中央代表会合。 The remnants of the West Route Army’s left detachment reached Xingxingxia and met the Central Committee’s representatives.
fields.description: 1937 年 4 月底，李先念率西路军左支队 400 余人到达甘新交界的星星峡；5 月 1 日前后，党中央代表陈云、滕代远等到星星峡接应，5 月 7 日到达乌鲁木齐，整编为「新兵营」。本坐标为星星峡镇代表点。 At the end of April 1937, Li Xiannian led more than 400 survivors of the West Route Army’s left detachment to Xingxingxia on the Gansu–Xinjiang border. Around 1 May, the Central Committee’s representatives Chen Yun and Teng Daiyuan arrived to receive them; on 7 May they reached Ürümqi and were reorganized as the “New Soldiers’ Camp.” The coordinate is a representative point at Xingxingxia town.
